sentences: I love to write and I have my own blog where I frequently express my opinions on different fields such as sports, politics, movies etc.
I have always dreamt of becoming a full time writer and would love to start this endeavor by writing about our country’s history.
India is a country with rich heritage.
Our country’s history is full of folklores and marked by events that changed the course of history.
I have a keen interest in the history of our country and would love to learn and write more about it, particularly the period of struggle for independence.
I have already started my research and have read a lot about in our history books that how India became a colony of The East India Company and how the movement for freedom started.
The East India Company landed on the shores of India in the 17th century under the pretense of trade with Indian merchants.
What began as a trade soon became an invasion and before anybody could realize India became a colony of Britain.
The East India Company deployed divide and rule policy to undermine the unity of Indian states.
The infighting between Indian states was unduly exploited by the company.
While the princely states were engaged in fighting with each other, the company slowly and gradually gained control over smaller provinces and critical administrative functions of the country.
Once the company monopolized administrative functions it was a matter of time that the whole country became their property.
The company ruled over India for 200 years without any real resistance because they managed to manipulate the rulers of several Indian states for their own benefits.
But in 1857 the mutiny against British rule was ignited by a small yet a highly significant event in the context of India’s fight for freedom.
A small group of traders were forced by the company’s merchants to use bullet covers that were made from animal skin.
Since it was against their religious belief so they were resisted it which led to a skirmish between the traders and British soldiers.
After this event the fight for freedom gained the impetus which it lacked before.
In the following years many prominent leaders emerged and led this movement for freedom.
Like other revolutions, India’s revolution was also marked with some extremely gory events in which many people sacrificed their lives for this cause.
On the other end of the spectrum there were legends like Mahatma Gandhi who believed in the concept of non-violence and fought this was with unwavering faith in this concept.
Finally on 15 August 1947 British agreed to relinquish control over India.

Now I want to write about all these incidents and put them in the contemporary context so that I can make our youngsters realize that the free air we are breathing today came at a hefty cost and now we have a responsibility to do justice to the sacrifices made and take this country towards the destiny which our freedom fighters had envisaged.

sentences: Modern man is leading a very mechanical life.
Every day is a struggle to strive and for some to survive.
Our daily routines have become intense and are full of concerns.
This precisely is the reason that every now and then we need some light hearted moments to relax our nerves and slow down.
Nothing beats humour in accomplishing this, but in these days humour is in short supply.
Few are lucky enough to have friends or family members with good sense of humour but there is one person who has brought the smiles on the faces of millions of people of my nation.
That person is actor Robert Green, a renowned comedian.
He is undoubtedly the most popular comic actor in my country.
His prime time show ‘Comedy Hour’ is one of the most watched TV programs and has topped the charts of TRP on several occasions.
He is particularly known for his political satire.
He brings the issues concerning our nation to the fore in his own unique style.
While doing this he often makes fun of politicians and other public figures but at the same time ensures that he does not cross the line.
He achieves his aim with utmost aplomb.
He epitomizes diligence and integrity.
Fame did not come easy to him as he spent nearly a decade in obscurity as a struggling actor.
He started his career as a stand-up comedian and for the first five years of his career barely scraped through by performing in night clubs.
After which he started gaining popularity and his name started doing rounds in the acting community.
He had to wait for another five years before his big break when he was spotted by a movie casting director.
He was impressed by his spontaneity and wittiness, and offered him a small role in an upcoming movie.
Although the role was short, Robert managed to leave his mark which led to more offers from other film makers.
He established himself as a great comedian in the film industry but the turning point in his career was when a leading TV channel offered him his own show.
That is how ‘Comedy Hour’ started and since then he has been winning the hearts of the people of this nation with his remarkable sense of humour.

sentences: Music is one thing I absolutely love.
Nothing excites me more than great music.
I have inherited this predilection for music from my mother who is a trained singer.
She started teaching me music from my childhood and made sure I participated in the school musical events.
In those events my talent was highly appreciated which intensified my love for music.
I dream of becoming a professional singer one day and in order to accomplish that I have to take the path less taken.
There are two prerequisites to become a singer.
First is obviously the hard work that is required to hone my skills and second is a great launch pad which would help me to begin my journey as a professional singer.
I have already taken care of the former and for the latter I have the perfect thing in mind.
Every two years in my country a musical competition called ‘Star Singer’ is organized.
It is orchestrated by one of the leading TV channels and is judged by three of most prominent music composers of our country.
The aim of the competition is to scout for talented singers and present them to the nation’s audience.

I have a firm belief in my abilities but it is not going to be easy to partake in this competition because every year thousands of talented singers audition for this competition and only 15 are finally selected.

I have seen the selection rounds of previous editions on TV and some of the singers were really impressive but even they got rejected because judges were looking for a complete singer who not only can sing but also had a great stage presence.
In essence their search culminates with a performer.
When the final 15 are selected then each judge takes 5 singers under his patronage.
They are trained by their mentors and are given a chance to perform every week.
Their performance is watched by the entire nation after which people are requested to vote for their favorite performer through SMS.
The contestant with the least number of votes is eliminated next week.
This process repeats until we have a winner of the contest.
The winners of previous editions have already become established singers.
That is why I would like to compete in this event and strive to fulfill my childhood dream.

sentences: Every person should have a role model to look up to.
Since I have a keen interest in politics therefore I follow several politicians.
There are a few prominent politicians whom I really admire such as our Prime Minster Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and many more.
But there is one particular leader whom I adulate for her personal traits and would love to spend a day with.
And that leader is our Union Health Minister Mrs. Suneeta Mehra.

I absolutely admire her for two important reasons, first is that she has made her mark in the field of politics which is primarily dominated by the male leaders and second is her humble background and how through her sheer tenacity and doggedness she has been able to scale the heights which few can only dream of.
The things I have heard about her in media and internet are a great source of inspiration for youngsters like me.
There is a specific reason that she has been made the Union Health Minister and that is her focus on improving the health standards of the youngsters.
She is practically the first politician in India who has brought focus on fitness.
I read about her daily routine in her interview in which she mentioned that irrespective of her busy schedule she always manages to take out time for her daily workout.
I would love to spend a day with her and see how she does that even after being one of the most sought after personalities in India.
She also said that for her integrity and fitness are above any other ability.
She is also known for her humility and altruistic nature.
She is a philanthropist and runs a charity for differently abled children of our society.
Every now and then we can see her on TV espousing a noble cause for example, abiding of traffic rules or planting more trees in our neighbourhood or promoting girl education.
Recently she was in the news because she announced that it would be mandatory for schools to teach yoga to students starting from first grade.

She justified this mandate by saying that good habits should be inculcated from the very early stage of a person and since kids are highly impressionable so it becomes even more important that they are taught the right lifestyle at schools.
Another example of her firm belief in the importance of fitness in our lives.
Last month she set another example for youngsters to follow when she announced that she has turned vegetarian and would urge other people to do the same.
She is highly respected in our nation not only as a great leader but also as a great human being.
I would dearly love to meet her in person and inculcate some of her traits in my personality.

sentences: In today’s world the bond between children and parents is not as strong as it used to be in the past and the main reason behind this negative development is lack of time which all family members spend together.
Parents are busy in their daily chores and children spend most of their time on their gadgets like laptops and smartphones.
This is not only impacting the closeness between the relations, it is also leading to other problems like communication gap and in some cases lack of respect for the parents among the children.
Fortunately I have been blessed with a great family and right from the childhood my parents have inculcated the right habits in me and my brother.
When most of the children of my age were getting ipads and mobile phones, my parents gave me books to read and every night my mother would come to our room and read those books with us.
My parents have always ensured that everyday all the members of the family would spend some time together and discuss small matters that interest all of us.
Another tradition which they started and is still part of our routine is to do some kind of leisure activity every week outside our home to change the atmosphere.
Every Sunday evening all of us together go to a park nearby our home and sometimes we call our friends as well to make the activities we do there more fun.
As I mentioned earlier that it has become a tradition so everybody in my families makes sure that do not make any other plans for Sunday evening.
We go to the park around 5 in the evening and the first thing we do is just sit and relax for 15 minutes.
In those 15 minutes our parents teach us to appreciate nature and everything it has given to us.
After that we play some casual games like throwing frisbee and volleyball.
My parents have always emphasised on all round development of their children therefore they always encourage us to play sports and not only focus solely on studies.
My father always says that a fit mind can only reside in a fit body and always treat your body like a temple.
After playing those games we take a break for another 15 minutes and relax.
The last activity that we do before leaving for home is yoga.
My father is a strong believer in the benefits of yoga and we do some basic yoga exercises for nearly half an hour.
On our way home our parents treat us with some sweets like ice cream or traditional Indian dishes.
I have to admit that every week I wait for Sunday with bated breath because I always look forward to all the fun we have in the park and I enjoy every moment their to the hilt.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
But there is one particular day when I really had a great time in the park.
That day I got up real early and decided to have a run in the park.
After running for half an hour I decided to take a break and sat on one of the benches which are set up near the boundaries of the park.
Suddenly I heard a huge roar of so many people.
When I turned towards the direction the sound was coming from I saw a group of elderly people doing some sort of strange thing.
Then I remembered that the aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
So I decided to join that group.
At first they were a bit surprised to see a youngster among them because they were not used to have young children in their group.
When I told them I want to try this therapy they warmly welcomed me and apprised me of the method which they said is a kind of ritual of their group.
I started following their every move and laughed and stopped whenever they did.
An exercise which started just as an experiment ended up being one of the most satisfying experiences of my life.
I never thought that a youngster could enjoy the company of old people so much.
After the routine they invited me to have snacks with them.
While having snacks they shared their life experiences with me which were enlightening to say the least.

They also asked me about my future plans and when I told them that I intend to become an engineer, one of the group members who had retired as an engineer talked to me at length about this field and that discussion dispelled so many doubts which I had previously.

sentences: It is said that music is food for soul and I could not agree more.
The reason music has a universal acceptance is that there is music for every kind of situation and mood.
It transcends borders and races.
For me music is the biggest stress buster and my favourite pastime.

I have created separate playlists which solve different purposes such as one playlist is full of songs which help me to relax while there is a playlist comprising of some peppy songs which I switch on whenever I am feeling a bit low.
Although I enjoy different genres of music and there are quite a few songs which I have listened to umpteen times, there is one song in particular which is really close to my heart.
The song’s title is ‘In the end’ and it is composed by band Linkin Park, suffice to say it is my favourite band as well.
No other band has been able to resonate with youngsters like Linkin Park has.
Recently this band visited India and I was lucky enough to get tickets for their concert.
The band started the concert with the song ‘In the end’.
Band’s lead singer Chester Bennington is a true youth icon.
The moment he played the song I knew I was listening to something unique.
The song began with strange sounding music which was created with the help of an instrument which is used exclusively by this band.
The music played for around 15 seconds after which the tempo of the song picked up by introducing guitar and drum the two instruments without which rock music is inconceivable.
But the main highlight of the concert was Chester’s husky voice and the lyrics of the song.
There is an aroma of enigma the way he sings.
The concert lasted for more than 3 hours and I thoroughly enjoyed every single second of it.
After the performance was over the band met with few lucky spectators behind the stage and I was one of them.
I even got a selfie with the band and it is one of the most cherished memories of my life.
I have made a poster of that selfie and it is pasted on the wall of my bedroom.

sentences: Every person should have a role model in his life to look up to.
For me that person is my father.
He has always treated me like a friend and always made me feel special.
I have received several gifts from my parents and all those are special to me.
But there is one gift which I would remember for a long time.
This gift was given with a purpose and a lesson, which I did not realize at first.
On my 16th birthday my father gave me 5000 rupees.
He told me that I could do whatever I want with that money and asked me to think about it for a day and inform him about my wish the next day.
I was a bit a perplexed because firstly I was not expecting money as a gift and secondly the amount was really significant for a 16 year old.
My first thought was to buy the gaming console which I had been yearning for some time but I had suspected that my father had an ulterior motive behind such generosity.
So I gave a hard thought about what I should do with that money.
I thought about it all night but could not fix my mind on one thing.
So next day I talked to my father and told him about my indecisiveness.
He said that he would help me with that but first he would tell me that why he gave me money on my birthday.
So he told me that this gift was meant to teach me the importance of money and the habit of saving it.
My father had a humble background and was brought up with very limited resources at his disposal.
He has worked diligently throughout his life to establish himself and to ensure that his family has all the comforts which he could not get in his childhood.
His hardships has taught him the importance of money and he wanted me to learn this lesson at a very early age, hence this gift.
He told me that saving money is as important as earning it.
He gave me his own example, that how he has saved some amount every year for my higher education which would have been difficult to generate in a lump sum.
He also told me about his emergency fund in which he contributes a small proportion of his income every month for untoward events.
So he suggested me to open a bank account with the gift he gave me and to contribute to that account from my monthly pocket money.
I heeded his advice and since then have been depositing small amount to this account every month.

He has won several accolades and has made his family proud.

He always tries to think out of the box.
He always tells me that a person should never stop learning whatever his age might be because the day we stop learning is the day we stop growing as an individual.
His ideas and opinions always challenge the normal rules of the society and the reason behind that is his inquisitive nature.
And because of this unorthodox thinking he is sometimes considered a bit of an iconoclast.
He always has questions about everything and likes to get to the bottom it.
He is not the one to take things on their face value and does not easily accept it if it does not make sense to him.
He often argues with his parents on several topics and I have to say sometimes his arguments are hard to beat.

I particularly enjoy the discussion between him and one of his uncles who is a deeply religious person.
Whenever he comes to their place it is inevitable that a conversation would start between these two around some religious topic and it would last for couple of hours.
These conversations are entertaining as well as enlightening.
His uncle is never affronted by his inquiries on the contrary he is impressed by his ability to question and learn.
Since he asks a lot questions he has developed a perspective about almost everything.
He is a sports fanatic and it is almost impossible to win an argument on sports against him.
Once I accidentally mentioned that our cricket team captain should be dropped from the team because of his recent failures.
The word dropped was enough to get him started after which he gave me a 15 minutes long lecture countering my opinion and at the end of which he managed to convince me otherwise.

sentences: School days are easily the best days of anybody’s life.
We make friends and memories whom we enjoy for the rest of our lives.
My school time was no different.
Me and my school friends often meet on weekends and reminisce about our school adventures.
While it was fun to spend time with friends at school, there were some challenging times as well particularly when I used to study maths.
I was an above average student at school and performed considerably well in most of the subjects but in maths I have to confess I struggled a bit.
For most of the subjects I studied on my own but for maths I took extra classes because I knew I needed help with the subject.
During the exam time I always earmarked extra time for maths and studied for couple of extra days in comparison to other subjects.
I vividly remember my continuous struggle with maths during school days but now things have taken a strange turn.
Maths has become my favorite subject and I would attribute this rekindled love for maths to one topic which I learnt in school.
And topic is the concept of probability.
For many students probability is the toughest topic in maths and I too found it really challenging and to be honest was one of the reasons I dreaded maths in school.
But my tenacity helped me in surmounting this challenge and I painstakingly comprehended the fundamentals of probability.
Probability as the name suggests is the ability to calculate the likelihood of any event.
It is a highly complex skill to learn as it requires counterintuitive thinking to calculate probability of anything.
But once I learnt this skill I realized how important and useful it is.
If we think logically then every decision we make in our lives is driven by probability.
Our decisions always have choices to make and we should make the best choice for us.
Now how do we decide which choice is best for us.
This decision should be made on the basis of event that is most likely to happen and which is deciphered by using the concept of probability.
For example recently my father decided to buy a car for the family.
We had shortlisted two models from two different manufacturers but could not decide any further.
That is when I used my probability skills to make the final decision.
I gathered some data points about both the models such as service centres of each company, number of cars sold each year, number of accidents these two models were involved in.
Then I used these data points to figure out that which car is more likely to last long with low maintenance cost using the probability method I learnt in school.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I was really looking forward to this journey because I have always enjoyed traveling in a train especially for long journeys as it gives me opportunity to meet new people and learn from them.
In this journey as well I met a person who came aboard at the Delhi junction.
He seemed like a really nice person and when I told him that we are going to Andaman Islands he said that last year he went to the same place.
He shared his experience and guided me about tourist attractions of the Islands.
He also suggested us about the hotels that we should consider for our accommodation and how to stay away from some of the unscrupulous travel agents who are always looking to hoodwink the tourists.
He traveled with us till Kochi where he alighted the train.
Nearly 5 hours later the train reached its destination from where we left for the Islands.
Andaman is like no other place I have seen in India.
It is an epitome of nature’s creativity, with hills on one side and vast expanse of sea beach on the other.
There is so much greenery and open spaces that I could not believe such a place could exist in this modern urbanized world.
The frenzy of urbanization has not yet touched this part of our nation and there are still tribes present there which are living in their orthodox lifestyle.
I met a few guys from these tribes and was really fascinated with their way of living.
I also learnt about a few of their traditions which we would find absurd but are an integral part of their existence.
Their diet is also absolutely different from what we normally have in our daily lives.
Their diet primarily consists of sea creatures, some of which I cannot even imagine to ingest.
I was really enthralled by this visit as I got to see a completely different facet of mankind and nature.
It was a whole new experience for me, something I would remember till my last breath.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society would be a blessing in myriad ways.
The biggest contribution such park can make in improving our life quality is by improving the quality of air that we breathe.
Our city, like other major cities is highly polluted.
In winters the pollution reaches hazardous levels and severely affects the health of the people of our city.

Everybody knows that the best way to purify air is by planting more trees, so the greenery of this park would ensure that the air at least in our society is pure and fresh, and one can feel that freshness early in the morning in this park.
There are several other ways in which this park can help the people of our society to better their lives.
Youngsters and adults could frequently come to this park for physical activities.
Children can play their usual games such as football, cricket, badminton and adults can take their morning and evening walks in this park.
Such activities would enable these people to keep fit and healthy.
But the demography that would benefit the most from this park would be of elderly people who are retired or do not have regular activities to keep themselves busy.

Overall if such a park is built it would prove to be a great public utility for all the residents of our society.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveller.
I prefer to visit places that have some historical significance because I am intrigued by the folklores associated with such places.
I have seen nearly all the historically important places in my vicinity but there was one monument which had been sitting on the top of my bucket list for quite some time.
That famous building was Taj Mahal.
Last month I checked off this place too when my uncle’s family planned to visit it.

He had come to our place on 4 days long vacation and I was excited to hear when he told me a visit to Taj Mahal was part of his itinerary so both my family and his family made the plan to visit Taj Mahal and explore the Agra city in which it is situated.
We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Agra in 2 hours.
As expected there was a long queue of tourists outside the gates of Taj Mahal waiting to get inside and get a glimpse of this magnificent structure.
The security checks at the entrance were robust and everybody was getting frisked thoroughly.
Finally we went past security checks and entered an aisle where we were given shoe covers which prevent the floor of the building from getting dirty.
The moment I laid my eyes on it I was completely enchanted by the view in front of my eyes.
I had never seen anything so beautiful before, the view was absolutely surreal.
The entire covering of white marvel gave it a heavenly look.
I had seen many historical monuments but the painstaking manner in which Taj Mahal is built is simply exceptional.
After leaving mesmerized by the beauty of Taj Mahal I left from there with my family as we had other popular destination in Agra as well on our checklist.
The next stop was the famous food shop by the name of Bikaner Authentic.
The food shop is popular for its authentic recipes and people who visit Agra do not leave without giving its delicacies a try.
We all ordered something for ourselves and I ordered a dish by the name of Original Bikaner Thali.
When my order arrived I was simply amazed by the presentation of the food in the plate.
It was a work of art the manner in which all the dishes were arranged and the taste also lived up to its expectations.
All of us were very pleased with the food we had there and then we left for our last stop on our journey to Agra, the Agra Museum which is popular for its heritage collection of artefacts.
The crowd inside the museum was a testimonial of its popularity and look on the faces of people were of amazement because some of the artefacts dated back to 17th century.
The collection varied from the weapons of famous kings of Agra to the stunningly designed jewellery of the queens.
All of us thoroughly enjoyed our trip to Agra and I can confidently say that it is one of most memorable trips of my life so far.

sentences: After completing my graduation I had to choose my future career path.
I was presented with two options.
First was to join an accounting company and work for someone else, and second was to join my family business.

Since I had done my graduation in the field of commerce, I was well suited for the accounting job, but I also realized that I can utilize my knowledge to grow my family business which my father had established with years of hard work.
Ours is a business of bags manufacturing.
We make bags primarily for educational institutes including schools, colleges, private coaching academies and universities.
My father started this business when he was 25 years old.
He began his journey as an intern under his uncle who also was in same business.
For the first three years he worked along side his uncle and learnt the intricacies of the bags business.
This was the time when he used to travel a lot to meet prospective clients and to take repeat orders from the existent customers.
This helped him to make important contacts in the industry at every part of the value chain.
Two years later he decided to take the plunge and start his own venture.
Fortunately he had the blessings, support and experience of his uncle by his side.
He set up a small manufacturing unit close to our ancestral home from where he catered to the local industry.
Since then we have established a state wide presence with more than 150 clients.
Now we are aiming to penetrate other states and are in talks with prospective local partners.
Owing to my commerce background I joined the accounts department of my company.
In two years I have managed to bring down the costs which has helped to improve our margins.
My father is conspicuously happy with my determination and I can see that feeling of pride on his face when senior managers talk of my contribution.
I am really glad that I opted to join my family business and I would leave no stone unturned to take this business to new heights.

sentences: I am a movie buff and spend most of my spare time watching movies.
I mostly watch sci-fi or action movies but recently I watched a movie which was actually recommended to me by my father.

He told me that after watching this movie I will be a changed person as this movie teaches some real and hard lessons about life and society in general and he was absolutely true and now I have recommended almost all of the my friends to see this movie at least once.
The movie I am talking about is titled ‘Pursuit of Happiness’.
The protagonist in the movie whose name is John Walter is played by the famous actor Will Smith.
The movie is about his life struggles and how he finally overcomes all the hurdles with his sheer perseverance and tenacity.
John Walter is a man in his mid-forties and is jobless.
He has a 7 year old son.
He lives in one room apartment and daily searches for menial jobs to pay for the rent and put the food on the table for himself and his son.
There are days when could not get any job and he would come home without any food, and that night he would tell stories to his starving son so that he can go to sleep without eating food.
In spite of all these hardships John is a strong willed person and always looks for ways to improve his situation.
One day he reads in a newspaper that there is an opening in a brokerage firm but in order to apply for that job the candidate must have basic knowledge of financial fundamentals.
John makes up his mind that he would not apply but also get his job.
He buys a couple of books on finance and after working hard for whole day and putting his son to sleep he would go out on street to read those books.
That becomes his routine for next one month and everyday he barely sleeps for two hours.
But he has been shown to be a person with indomitable spirit and never say die attitude.
Finally when he thinks that he is ready for the job interview he applies for the job.
Luckily he gets a call for the interview the next week.
His interview is scheduled at 2 pm and before that he took a day job since he still needs the money to pay for the apartment rent and food.
On the day of the interview he took the job of road painting.
He had planned to finish his quota of job by 1 pm and then go back to his apartment change his clothes and then leave for the interview.
But unfortunately on that day one of the crew members called in sick so the contractor told all workers that they have to put in extra half an hour and those who do not would not get paid.
This complicated the matters for John who badly needed both money from the job as well as that brokerage job.
Being a responsible father he decides to put in the extra half an hour so that he can feed his son in the night and leaves for the interview directly from the job site in his dishevelled clothes.

When he reached the office of brokerage firm he saw other candidates sitting there in their corporate suits with neck ties and well polished shoes, while John was standing there in his sneakers and white shirt spoiled with different colors.
The interview started and candidates were called in one by one.
Some of the candidates looked satisfied while other came out of the interview room with a dejected look which depicted their experience inside the room.
When John’s turn came his heart was pounding, he gently opened the door and entered the room.
At first glance everybody was shocked at the appearance of John.
The panel was about to casually reject him when John requested just five minutes to explain his situation.
Then he tells about his whole life situation, how hard has he prepared for this interview and the reason why he came to interview looking like this.
After hearing his side of the story the panellists got interested and impressed by his tenacity.

They were looking for someone like John who never gives up but still there was technical side of the job that had to be catered to so one of the panellists asked John about the world of finance and all the knowledge of fundamentals that were required to be even considered for the job.
John answered all the questions with utmost aplomb and every member of the panel was mighty impressed by his sound knowledge of world of finance.

One of the panellists even complemented him by saying that his knowledge superseded the knowledge of all candidates who appeared before him with flashy degrees but no practical knowledge of either finance or life.
John knew his interview went well but also knew that odds were against him because of his age since these brokerage firms prefer to recruit young people who could be moulded by the management.

He waited for the call back from the firm and for next ten days there was no response and then suddenly he gets a call from the front office of the firm that the partners of the firm want to meet him again but the receptionist did not confirm whether he has got the job or not.

This time John appears for the meeting in a proper suit and the moment he enters the office the same panel is sitting there who looked a bit bemused after seeing John in suit since they still had this image of John in white shirt full of colors.

The head of the panel started the conversation and told John that under normal circumstances they would not hire someone in his forties and with no prior experience but they were mighty impressed by his knowledge of financial world and more by his attitude towards life and work. So they offered him the position of junior broker at the firm.
For a moment John thought he was dreaming, he simply could not believe his ears and started crying because this the first good news he has heard in his life for a long long time.
He immediately accepts the offer and spends rest of the day with his son to celebrate this achievement.
After watching this movie I sat down with my father and he asked what did I learn from the movie.

I told him that I learnt two important lessons, one that a person should never stop trying to improve his situation and everyday should be spent on becoming a better person than yesterday by learning something new, and second lesson was that there are not guarantees in life, good situation can turn into bad and bad situation can turn into good in matter of days, so we should be prepared for that and never get disheartened or discouraged no matter what life throws at us.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
But there is one particular day when I really had a great time in the park.
It was a Sunday and I got up real early and decided to have a run in the park.
After running for half an hour I decided to take a break and sat on one of the benches which are set up near the boundaries of the park.
Suddenly I heard a huge roar of so many people.
When I turned towards the direction the sound was coming from I saw a group of elderly people doing some sort of strange thing.
Then I remembered that the aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
So I decided to join that group.
At first they were a bit surprised to see a youngster among them because they were not used to have young children in their group.
When I told them I want to try this therapy they warmly welcomed me and apprised me of the method which they said is a kind of ritual of their group.
I started following their every move and laughed and stopped whenever they did.
An exercise which started just as an experiment ended up being one of the most satisfying experiences of my life.

sentences: I have been blessed with an amazing family.

Deciding to give them gift was easy but what to gift was the hard part because I knew that no material commodity would give them the satisfaction which I wanted them to feel.
I was really hard pressed about selecting the gift and thought about it for days.
I was really confused and shared my conundrum with my friend Arun.
And I am glad that I did that because he suggested me something which immediately felt right to me and would solve both my purpose.

He said that I should prepared a collage of all the family photos which should include my parents’ marriage, their children’s childhood, all the family trips that we have made so far and enjoyed together.
I really liked this idea because I knew that this collection of photos would be reminiscent of all the great moments of my parents’ life and they would once again relive and enjoy these memories.
I had decided the gift but the next problem was how to prepared it because I did not know how to prepare a well crafted collage.
I could manage some photo editing but I wanted it to be perfect so I asked again my friend for help and he suggested me a website that prepares such collages online for their users.
He had used it himself and assured me that this website is the best in the field and their customer service is delightful.
So I opened that website and registered an account, immediately a chat window opened and one of their representative greeted me and asked what exactly I was looking for.
I told her everything about the collage and she immediately started helping me in preparing the collage.
First she understood all my requirements and asked me to upload all the photos which I wanted to be in the collage.
Then she showed me some their best templates which users generally use to prepared collages.
Although I liked those collages but I told her that I would like prepare my own template to give it a personal touch.

I was initially apprehensive while making this request because I knew that making a new template from scratch is a time consuming process and I was not sure that the executive would agree to this because of the time constraint which these people have.
But to my surprise she was more than happy to help me and both of us started preparing a new template for the collage.
The executive was extremely patient and accommodated all my requests while preparing the collage.

She implemented all the changes that I suggested, sometimes I requested multiple changes on a single photo but she was as calm as a monk and on top of that she recommended some changes from herself based on her experience which really enhanced the quality of the collage.

It took us around two hours to prepared the template and the final collage and during those two hours I never felt any kind of frustration in her voice or got the feeling that she was rushing to finish my request.
I regularly shop online and deal with all types of customer care executives but I can definitely say that this was the best experience I had in my life while shopping online.
After finishing the job she kindly asked if there was anything else I needed help with.
I thanked her from the bottom of my heart and shared my feeling of respect which I had developed towards her and their services and promised to recommend their website to as many people as possible.

Government of India has made it mandatory for companies to spend a certain ratio of their profit on CSR activities.

Apart from education, CSR activities which impart vocational training to these people are also highly beneficial.

So far CSR legislation is binding on corporations only, but I would urge ordinary citizens as well to make meaningful contributions towards our society.
If we all decide to make these contributions however small these might be, it would lead to a better future for all of us.
And also I would like to see that we all follow all the laws and rules religiously as these are meant for our benefit only.

I had also become a victim of this digital phenomenon but I found a way to better my lifestyle and brought some changes in my daily routine.

I had always heard about the benefits of meditation and had been thinking of experiencing it first hand for long period of time.
But because of my busy schedule and to some extent my reluctance I did not take it up.
It was in my last summer vacations when I first tried meditation.
To be honest initially it was hard to persist because I began with wrong expectation of immediate results.
My father saw me getting frustrated and on the brink of quitting.
So one day he sat with me and explained to me that meditation is like a saving account with compound interest.
Initial returns might be low but the longer I invest in it the higher returns would be.
I heeded his advice and stuck to my daily routine of 30 minutes of meditation.
I am glad I did it.
I can proudly say that I am a better person now.
I don’t get perturbed easily while performing the tasks that demand higher degree of diligence.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveller.

We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Agra, the city in which Taj Mahal is situated in 6 hours.
The journey to agra was as memorable as the visit to taj mahal.
Since we left early in the morning we did not have breakfast and decided to have it on our way to Taj Mahal.
Nearly after one hour we left our home we stopped at a famous restaurant by the name of Mother’s Kitchen.
The restaurant is known for its delicious recipes and exclusive dishes.
Everybody ordered food of his own choice and I ordered dish they call Mother’s omelette which was their special breakfast dish of the day.
I had never had such a delicious omelette before in my life.
I was impressed by not only the taste but the way it was presented on the table, it simply looked exotic.
Everybody truly enjoyed their meal and then got back in the car to resume our journey.
After few minutes my cousin suggested that we should play some game to break the monotony of the long journey.

So we decided to play traditional Indian musical game called Antakshri, in which a person from one team sings a song and when he finishes the song then someone from the opposite team has to sing a song starting from the word with which the person from team one ended is song.
We played this game for nearly an hour and really had a blast.
We almost forgot that we were sitting in the car, it felt as if we were having a great time in the living room of our home.
The whole journey to Agra was full of many more such memorable moments and I will cherish these moments for the rest of my life.

sentences: Every person should have a role model in his life to look up to.

He has always loved me like his own son and I cannot even count the number of gifts he has bought me since my childhood.
I too treat him like my father and have always looked for opportunities to show my appreciation for whatever he has done for me.
He is highly respected in our family because of many traits that he possesses but the one quality of his which I admire the most is his magnanimity.
He is always ready to help anyone in need and he would even go out of his way to ensure that the person in distress is relieved from his misery.
I have seen him so many times helping our family members in whatever way possible either financially or emotionally.
He is an active member of many social groups which work towards the betterment of the society.
One such group is an NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.

He told me that this NGO is very close to his heart because he firmly believes that children are the future of a nation and without proper education we cannot ensure a bright future for these children as well as the nation.
So by organizing these classes for the poor children he is contributing to a much larger cause.
That is why I simply admire my uncle.

He not only believes in doing such good deeds himself, he also believes in inculcating such great moral values in the younger generation and I am glad that true to his belief he once gave me an opportunity to make a small contribution in the larger scheme of things.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
So my uncle asked me if I would be willing to take those science sessions for one day, an invite which I gladly accepted.
I went to the camp with my uncle and began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the table.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO is doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveller.

Last month I checked off this place too when my uncle’s family planned to visit it.
He had come to our place on 4 days long vacation and I was excited to hear when he told me a visit to Taj Mahal was part of his itinerary.
We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Jaipur, the city in which Hawa Mahal is situated in 2 hours.
As expected there was a long queue of tourists outside the gates of Hawa Mahal waiting to get inside and get a glimpse of this magnificent structure.
The security checks at the entrance were robust and everybody was getting frisked thoroughly.
Finally we went past security checks and entered an aisle where we were given shoe covers which prevent the floor of the building from getting dirty.
I had heard a lot about the beauty of this monumental structure especially its colourful interior and went there will a lot of expectations.
The moment I laid my eyes on it I was completely enchanted by the view in front of my eyes.
I had never seen anything so beautiful before.
The view was absolutely surreal.
The entire inside of the main building including wall and ceiling were covered with breath-taking paintings.
I had seen many historical monuments but the painstaking manner in which these paintings were done is simply exceptional.
I had never seen such a beautiful and colourful place in my life before.
Everything is just perfect.
The vibrant colours in the paintings give the feeling as if these are real and you can talk to the persons in the paintings.
The two pillars on either side of the main structure stand tall like royal guards and are covered with colourful designs.
There are two small rose gardens on either side of passageway that leads to the main building.
While crossing through that passageway it felt as if the royalties are still residing there.
The main building encompasses the tomb of the king who built this epitome of beauty.

I am still in awe of Hawa Mahal and startled because I cannot fathom that how the workers of that era managed to build such near perfect structure without the help of any technology and mechanical gadgets.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.

To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
The biggest contribution of this park in improving our life quality is by improving the quality of air that we breathe.
Our city, like other major cities is highly polluted.
In winters the pollution reaches hazardous levels and severely affects the health of the people of our city.

Everybody knows that the best way to purify air is by planting more trees, so the greenery of this park ensures that the air at least in our society is pure and fresh, and one can feel that freshness early in the morning in this park.
There are several other ways in which this park helps the people of our society to better their lives.
Youngsters and adults frequently come to this park for physical activities.
Children play their usual games such as football, cricket, badminton and adults take their morning and evening walks in this park.
Such activities enables these people to keep fit and healthy.
But the demography that benefits the most from this park is of elderly people who are retired or do not have regular activities to keep themselves busy.
The aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
Even in the evening these senior citizens sit together in the park and share their life experiences and reminisce over joyous moments of their lives.
Overall this park is a great public utility for all the residents of our society.

sentences: In my country the population has been growing at a steady rate.
More number of individuals means more facilities required for their survival including housing spaces.
Due to increased demand for residential spaces there has been a significant decline in green areas.
While the cutting down of trees has been indiscriminate, there is one plant which has recently come into great demand and people are actually planting it in their backyard gardens.
The plant is of kiwi fruit.
Few years back not many people had heard of this fruit.
But it suddenly shot to popularity when its medicinal property to fight the disease of dengue was discovered.
Every year during the period of September-october dengue fever spreads to certain parts of my country.
During that period it becomes an epidemic.
This happens because weather in that period is opportune for breeding of mosquitoes.
No doubt government authorities and people take certain precautions as they are well aware of its danger even then the disease spreads to considerable levels.
The most fatal effect of dengue fever is that it leads to a decline in count of white blood cells in the patient’s body which weakens his immune system and makes him vulnerable to serious infections.
This is where kiwi has proved to be highly effective.
It has been scientifically proven that ingestion of kiwi helps the body to generate new white blood cells which strengthens his immune system.
Hence it is a life saver for the patients of dengue.
Whenever someone is diagnosed with dengue the doctor immediately prescribes him to start taking this fruit.
The fruit has other therapeutic effects as well.
It contains high amount of fibre, so it also helps to improve digestive system.
The fruit is very easy to plant and grow that is why it is becoming a household item.

sentences: Education lays the foundation of a decent life for any individual.
It should be a fundamental right for every citizen.
I have been blessed with a family who deeply believes in the importance of education and has made sure that I have the best education possible.
I was an above average student in my school and my favorite subjects were maths and science.
These two subjects are paramount for intellectual growth of an individual as these challenge one’s ability to think and learn.
Maths is particularly important because of the basic practical skills it teaches us such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
These skills help us perform every day basic activities such as planning our family budget, paying for things and services that we buy and many more.
While these basic skills are the cornerstone of any mathematical teaching, there is one particular skill which I found really interesting and useful.
It is the ability to calculate probability.
I was taught about the concept of probability in my elementary school.
Probability as the name suggests is the ability to calculate the likelihood of any event.
It is a highly complex skill to learn as it requires counterintuitive thinking to calculate probability of anything.
But once I learnt this skill I realized how important and useful it is.
If we think logically then every decision we make in our lives is driven by probability.
Our decisions always have choices to make and we should make the best choice for us.
Now how do we decide which choice is best for us.
This decision should be made on the basis of event that is most likely to happen and which is deciphered by using the concept of probability.
For example recently my father decided to buy a car for the family.
We had shortlisted two models from two different manufacturers but could not decide any further.
That is when I used my probability skills to make the final decision.
I gathered some data points about both the models such as service centres of each company, number of cars sold each year, number of accidents these two models were involved in.
Then I used these data points to figure out that which car is more likely to last long with low maintenance cost using the probability method I learnt in school.

sentences: My city is known for two things – food and clothes.
The variety in both the categories is just staggering.

But there is one particular product that is like the crown jewel of my hometown and has vouchsafed a distinction to our city because of its uniqueness and popularity and that is the bamboo guitar.
My city has a rich tradition in the field of music and has produced many distinguished musicians who were popular not only in India but worldwide.
The production of musical instruments from bamboo was started by a local family of musicians nearly a century ago.
Initially they manufactured the traditional instruments like sitar and flute which are integral part of Indian classical music.

But in the year 1968 one of the young members of that family went to the USA and there he got his first taste of rock music and was completely enthralled by the mesmerizing music coming out of the guitar.
He came back and shared his experience with his family members and suggested that they should start making their own version of bamboo guitar.
Everybody liked the idea and they started to work on it.
Within a year they produced their first version of bamboo guitar.
Initially the fans of rock music rejected it because it was not similar in looks to the conventional guitar and nobody knew what kind of music it would produce.

But when the family showcased their new product in one of musical concerts held in our city with a memorable performance with the guitar, everybody was on their feet and the bamboo guitar became a hot commodity overnight.
After that performance the family and their new invention bamboo guitar became the talk of the town and was gaining fast popularity among the prominent musicians of the country.
Many prominent figures from the musical industry came to visit that family and requested them to do a short performance with the guitar.
All of them were in awe of this new instrument and were simply bewildered that how such a simple looking piece of bamboo could produce such powerful music.

Gradually the word spread about the guitar outside India as well and in 1975 one of the greatest guitarists the world has ever seen Bob Dylan visited our small hometown to personally experience the magic of the instrument which people had been enchanted with.

The event was covered by global media and after the performance Bob Dylan was in tears and hugged the guitarists and that was the day when that simple invention of bamboo guitar became a global attraction.

sentences: A good schooling lays the foundation of a better life for any student because it is in school where we first learn the basics of everything.
So it is imperative for parents to put their children in the right which can provide the kind of guidance and great academic facilities.
I was lucky enough to start my schooling from one such great school.
My school’s name is St. Stephen’s Convent school and it is considered to the best school in our city.
I joined this school in the first standard and studied their still senior secondary.

The procedure of getting admission into the school is highly competitive and every year thousands of children apply for the admission but only the selected few are admitted as the school is very particular about its image hence they admit only those children whom they deem intellectually fit enough as per the standards of the school.
My parents prepared me well for the admission process and after few rounds of tests I got admission into the school and that was the day when my life changed for better.
The school is divided into three departments as per the classes.
The first department is responsible for classes 1 to 5, the second is responsible for classes 6 to 9 and third one looks after classes 10 to 12.

The first department focuses solely on building the basics of students in all the major subjects specifically science and maths because my school believes in developing scientific temper and groom students as thinker and not crammers of the subjects.
But the most important department is the third one for couple of reasons.

But the more significant function of this department is to prepare students for their future career choices.
Most of the students in higher secondary are confused about which stream to choose in senior secondary which could pave the way for bright career for them.
This is where this department plays a crucial rule.
The department has separate career councillors who guide the students to choose the right stream as per their interest and more importantly capability.

They do not only council students, they also meet with parents and make them understand that it is never a good idea to push their children to go for a particular stream just because it is a popular choice.

They apprise the parents of the repercussions if they force their children to choose a particular stream which could culminate into a stressful condition for the student if he is not mentally prepared or capable of performing in that stream.

I wish all the schools had such councillors because every year many students make the wrong choices under duress from their parents and we all know the unfortunate and extreme steps they can take afterwards.
I was lucky enough to be guided properly by one of the career councillors and I am extremely happy with the choice I made with his help.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I along with my family were sitting on a bench waiting for the train to arrive.
I was listening to music on my phone when it started ringing.
It was a call from an unknown number.
I picked up the call and on the other side I heard the sound of a man who sounded like a person in his fifties with a very mature voice.
He asked if it was the customer care number of ANZ bank and I told him that he had got the wrong number.
Either he had the wrong information about the customer care number or it was a case of wrong connection.
I said politely that it was a wrong number and was about to disconnect the call when I discerned some panic in his voice.
Just out of curiosity I asked him what had happened.
He told me that he had lost his credit card and is now worried that it might be misused which would result in a substantial financial loss to him.
That is why he was trying to reach the customer care of the bank to get his card blocked immediately.
I told him that he could do it himself from his mobile phone which he was apparently not aware of.
I was not surprised because generally people in his age group are not very tech savvy and use their mobile phones primarily for calling and messaging.
He requested me if I would be kind enough to take him through the process of blocking the card on the mobile phone.
It was an easy process so I thought of helping him out because I knew he could do it if I guided him properly.
So I told him to first install the mobile application of the bank if it was not installed already.
He told me that it was there on his phone, once I knew this, the rest was a matter of few clicks.
Next I told him to open the app and go to security settings.
He did that and asked me for the next step.
Then I told him to look for block/ unblock card options in that settings which he found immediately and knew what to do next because it was quite obvious from the name of the option.
He checked the box against block card option and immediately got an SMS saying that his credit card had been blocked.
He thanked my profusely and told me that I was a life saver.

I told him that it was not that big a favour and then I heard the siren of the train which signalled that our train was arriving at the station so I told him that I had to leave at which moment he again thanked me and wished me best of luck for my life endeavours.

sentences: Last year I completed my senior secondary.

I vividly remember it was the day of maths exam.
Like all other days I reached examination centre 15 minutes early.
On the entrance gate every student is asked for their entry pass issued by the board and only the students with the valid entry pass were allowed to enter the premises.
When I reached the gate and guard asked for my pass, I put my hands in pocket to get it out.
For first couple of seconds I could not find it so I thought I might be in my bag.
I rummaged through my bag as I was getting jittery.
Then it hit me that I had left my pass at home.
I explained the situation to the guard and pleaded him to enter the examination centre as the exam was about to start in 20 minutes.
But the guard said that his hands were tied by the rules and regulations and could not allow me without the entry pass.
I broke down with tears and had lost it completely when father of one of other candidate gave me some water to drink.
He asked where my house was and then he drove me to my house in his car.
I picked up the entry pass and then we drove back to the examination centre.
The exam had already started and I was half hour late.
I showed my entry pass and then the guard let me in.
I nervously started writing my test.
But because of paucity of time could not attempt the whole exam.
And when the result came as expected I had scored the lowest in maths as compared to other subjects.

sentences: I am a tech savvy person and like to use technology as much as possible.
I have a predilection for technology since it has made our lives so much convenient and we can do so many operations in the comfort of our homes without having to actually move out.
One such facility I use frequently is e banking.
It has been years since I have visited my bank’s branch because I can do basic operations like transferring money or do online shopping using the online banking facility.
But there are some basic operations which can be performed at the branches only and recently I had to visit the branch for one such requirement.
I got an email from my bank that my PAN is not linked with my bank account and I have to link it before the deadline failing which the bank would freeze my account.
The next day I went to the branch to link the PAN with my account.
It was a quite strange and honestly uncomfortable for me since I was not used to visiting bank branch and wait in lines.
I inquired about the process and the executive told me that I have to fill up an update form and provide the photocopy of my PAN and show the original to him.
When I opened my wallet to get my PAN I was disappointed to see that I was not carrying my PAN in my wallet.
I told the executive about the predicament.
He told me to call someone at home and send the photo of PAN on whatsapp.

As soon as I dialled my father’s number and started talking to him, the guard came to me and told me that customers are not allowed to use mobile phones within premises of the bank and if have to make any urgent call I have to move out of the branch and complete my call.
I looked at the executive and he showed me the board which clearly prohibited customers from using cell phones within the bank.
So I told my father and disconnected the call.
Then I moved out of the branch and dialled my father again and asked him to send the picture of my PAN card.
After few minutes he sent me the picture of the PAN card.
I went to nearby photocopy shop and got the photocopy of my PAN card.
Then I went back to the bank and showed the picture of my PAN card and submitted the photocopy along with the form to update.
While I about to leave I asked him that why are we not allowed to use mobile phones in the bank.
He told me that it is a guideline from the central bank of the country and everybody has to abide by it.
He further told me that this policy has been implemented for customers’ safety only.
I thanked him for the information and for his cooperation and left the bank.

sentences: India is country with rich heritage.
Our country’s history is full of folklores and marked by events that changed the course of history.
But no occasion is more momentous than the day we got independence from British.
15 August 1947 is the most important date in the history of India.
This was the day we regained not only our freedom but our identity as well.
The East India Company landed on the shores of India in the 17th century under the pretense of trade with Indian merchants.
What began as a trade soon became an invasion and before anybody could realize India became a colony of Britain.
The East India Company deployed divide and rule policy to undermine the unity of Indian states.
The infighting between Indian states was unduly exploited by the company.
While the princely states were engaged in fighting with each other, the company slowly and gradually gained control over smaller provinces and critical administrative functions of the country.
Once the company monopolized administrative functions it was a matter of time that the whole country became their property.
The company ruled over India for 200 years without any real resistance because they managed to manipulate the rulers of several Indian states for their own benefits.
But in 1857 the mutiny against British rule was ignited by a small yet a highly significant event in the context of India’s fight for freedom.
A small group of traders were forced by the company’s merchants to use bullet covers that were made from animal skin.
Since it was against their religious belief so they were resisted it which led to a skirmish between the traders and British soldiers.
After this event the fight for freedom gained the impetus which it lacked before.
In the following years many prominent leaders emerged and led this movement for freedom.
Like other revolutions, India’s revolution was also marked with some extremely gory events in which many people sacrificed their lives for this cause.
On the other end of the spectrum there were legends like Mahatma Gandhi who believed in the concept of non-violence and fought this was with unwavering faith in this concept.
Finally on 15 August 1947 British agreed to relinquish control over India.
On the eve of this day our first Prime Minister Jawarlal Nehru gave a speech which became a stuff of legends.
Every year we celebrate this day with supreme pride and in the memory of those who laid down their lives for the freedom of the posterity.

sentences: I have had several memorable moments in my life.
But there is one occasion which I will always cherish for my entire life and that is when I got 92% marks in my senior secondary exams.
This achievement is special to me for two reasons.
First is the hardships that I went through just before the exam.
Two months before the exams I fractured my left leg and could not go to my coaching classes.
So I did all the study at home on my own and I am glad that my hard work paid off.
And the second reason is the celebration which I had after achieving this feat.
Actually the whole thing was planned by my family and they kept it as a surprise till the last moment.
I was not aware of any such event and they really succeeded to keep this whole event as a secret from me.
My result came out on Wednesday and on Friday my father said that all of us are going for shopping to get some basic stuff for the home.
So we left at around 6:30 pm in the evening and I had no inkling what was to ensue.
I was surprised when our car entered one of most popular restaurants of our city and my father parked the car there and told us to come out of the car.
I was really confused and asked my father that why had we come here and he told me that he had a brief meeting with one of his friends after which they would leave to do their shopping.
So all of us entered the restaurant and followed my father who walked towards a room titled family hall.
That particular moment still flashes in my mind, the moment we entered the room the whole room lit up and for a moment I could not see anything.
Then gradually things started to sink in and I could see all our close relatives, my friends and their parents in the family hall.
All of them were shouting congratulations to me and when I looked at my father I could see the pride in his eyes with a small tear.
Then I realized that this whole event had been planned by my family to celebrate my achievement of scoring 92% marks.
There was a cake as well with a candle in the shape of number 92 on top of it.
All my relatives came to me and congratulated me and told me how proud they were of me.
My friends’ parents also said the same thing to me and said that they were glad that their children had a friend like me to whom they could look up to.
That was the proudest moment of my life and by the look on the faces of my parents I could say that for them as well it was one of the best moments of their lives.
That day I realized the real importance of my family and thanked god for blessing me with such great parents.

sentences: After completing my graduation I had to choose my future career path.
I was presented with two options.
First was to join an accounting company and work for someone else, and second was to join my family business.

Since I had done my graduation in the field of commerce, I was well suited for the accounting job, but I also realized that I can utilize my knowledge to grow my family business which my father had established successfully with years of hard work.
Ours is a business of bags manufacturing.
We make bags primarily for educational institutes including schools, colleges, private coaching academies and universities.
My father started this business when he was 25 years old.
He began his journey as an intern under his uncle who also was in same business.
For the first three years he worked along side his uncle and learnt the intricacies of the bags business.
This was the time when he used to travel a lot to meet prospective clients and to take repeat orders from the existent customers.
This helped him to make important contacts in the industry at every part of the value chain.
Two years later he decided to take the plunge and start his own venture.
Fortunately he had the blessings, support and experience of his uncle by his side.
He set up a small manufacturing unit close to our ancestral home from where he catered to the local industry.
Since then we have established a state wide presence with more than 150 clients.
Now we are aiming to penetrate other states and are in talks with prospective local partners.
Owing to my commerce background I joined the accounts department of my company.
In two years I have managed to bring down the costs which has helped to improve our margins.
My father is conspicuously happy with my determination and I can see that feeling of pride on his face when senior managers talk of my contribution.
I am really glad that I opted to join my family business and I would leave no stone unturned to take this business to new heights.

sentences: I am a gregarious person and like to meet new people.

sentences: I have been blessed with a great family.
