He has never asked something of me but recently he approached me for a small favour and I felt obliged to help him.
My uncle is associated with a leading NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
So my uncle asked me if I would be willing to take those science sessions for one day.
Initially I was apprehensive as I did not have any teaching experience but I did not want to disappoint my uncle since this was the first time he asked something of me.
Still I shared my doubt with him and he told me not to worry a lot and promised me that I would love this opportunity.
And he proved to be exactly right.
I began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the plate.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO was doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.
He promised me that he would arrange something for me in the near future.

sentences: Today’s modern life has become very hectic.

Everybody has his or her way to spend these pleasurable moments.
I like to resort to reading whenever I get free time because reading not only relaxes me it also empowers me to grow intellectually.
Reading on different topics allows me to build an all-round perspective.
Although I like to read on all important topics for a holistic improvement, I particularly enjoy reading philosophy.
I know the general perception about philosophy is that it is a heavy and insipid subject but I find it really interesting and some of the books I have read are really exciting.

Recently when I had a couple of holidays and was absolutely free I picked up a book titled ‘The Daily Stoic’ which I can proudly say that I finished in one sitting and the reason behind this achievement is the content of the books which had me hooked from start to finish.
It is a collection of teachings of several prominent ancient Greek philosopher such as Plato, Aristotle and Socrates.
This book is considered the bible of philosophers.
I found this book exciting because it provides a completely different view on life.
It taught me a way to simplify life which we have otherwise made so complicated with our desires.
There is no human being on this planet whose entire life is a bed of roses.
Everybody has to go through hardships at some stage of his or her life and these are the times when one’s character is tested.
What I have learnt from this book is that during tough times the most important thing is to maintain one’s integrity.
The teachings in this book are not meant for a weak-willed person.
While these teachings are pleasing to read but to inculcate these in your daily life is highly challenging and this challenge is what I find the most exciting.
I know if I am able to implement only few of the instructions given in this book, I would come out as a better and an enlightened human being.
I can easily say that reading this book was the best utilization of my free time on that day.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
But there is one particular day when I really had a great time in the park.
That day I got up real early and decided to have a run in the park.
After running for half an hour I decided to take a break and sat on one of the benches which are set up near the boundaries of the park.
Suddenly I heard a huge roar of so many people.
When I turned towards the direction the sound was coming from I saw a group of elderly people doing some sort of strange thing.
Then I remembered that the aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
So I decided to join that group.
At first they were a bit surprised to see a youngster among them because they were not used to have young children in their group.
When I told them I want to try this therapy they warmly welcomed me and apprised me of the method which they said is a kind of ritual of their group.
I started following their every move and laughed and stopped whenever they did.
An exercise which started just as an experiment ended up being one of the most satisfying experiences of my life.
I never thought that a youngster could enjoy the company of old people so much.
After the routine they invited me to have snacks with them.
While having snacks they shared their life experiences with me which were enlightening to say the least.

They also asked me about my future plans and when I told them that I intend to become an engineer, one of the group members who had retired as an engineer talked to me at length about this field and that discussion dispelled so many doubts which I had previously.

sentences: I am a hyper active person and like to keep myself busy.

The name written on the license was John and the address mentioned was two blocks away from my home.
I immediately started sympathizing with John because I knew that without driving license I impossible to drive through the city and do your daily activities.

I still remember the pain and struggle I had to go through to get my license.
I first applied for a learning license and then the department gave me 500 page book to prepare for my written exam which I had to clear before taking the drive tests.
In the first attempt I failed in my written examination which was kind of embarrassing for me.

In the second attempt I somehow scraped through the written exam but when it came to the drive test, believe me it is easier to get a tiger to eat grass than satisfy those examiners who sit on the passenger seat in the driving seat.
In the first driving test I did not switch on the turn light while taking a turn, he failed me.

sentences: It is commonly said that prevention is better than cure.

I vividly remember it was the time of September.
Every year this time around the likelihood of diseases like dengue and malaria increases because of high breeding of mosquitoes.
Thousands of people catch these diseases and this year I was one of those unfortunate victims.
It started with a mild fever and body ache.
When it persisted for few days and decided to get myself checked.
When I explained my symptoms the doctor straight away wrote some tests for my fever as he feared the worst.
Reports came and I was diagnosed with dengue.
Luckily it was caught at a very nascent stage and the doctor started my medication immediately.
I was administered the prescribed medicine for dengue along with glucose drips and appropriate diet.
Everyday I had to take the pills for my fever thrice a day.
Also I was given injections on alternate days to fight the infection which has spread throughout my body.
My medication continued for three weeks after which my condition had improved significantly with no fever and very low levels of infection.
For few more days I was kept under observation.
It was a terrible experience for me physically as well as mentally.
And after going through this I just hope that we all take correct measures to eradicate such diseases from our society.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.

I along with my family were sitting on a bench waiting for the train to arrive.
Five minutes later a man in his mid 40s came and sat beside me.
He immediately took out his phone and dialed someone.
I did not mean to eavesdrop on his conversation but it caught my attention when he mentioned the words medical, non-medical, IT, computer science and job placement.
I discerned from his conversation that he was talking about career choices for someone, most likely his child or someone close to him.
And I turned out to be right when he further said that his son is not sure which stream to choose for his professional studies.

So I asked him to try it once more in front of me so that I could see what he was trying to do and why was he failing in this endeavor.
The basic information that is required to create a gmail account is your full name, age, country and contact number.
He had filled everything correctly yet google was rejecting his gmail application.
Even I was confounded for a moment because everything seemed right to me at the first glance.
Then I gave it a keen look and realized that both of us had misses a nuance.

As it happened at that time my brother was a minor and for minors gmail had a policy that they could not open a gmail account until they provided contact information of his guardian and got it verified from the guardian.
So I told him to put my gmail id in the guardian’s contact column.
As soon as he did it I got a confirmation email from google.
I opened that email and gave my consent to my brother’s gmail account.
Once Google received my consent, my brother proceeded with the process of opening his own gmail account and this time he succeeded.

He was relieved eventually but I told him that this should teach him a lesson that while doing such things on internet he should be very careful and should be mindful of small details because these seen minor but prove to be very critical as it was in this case.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I was really looking forward to this journey because I have always enjoyed traveling in a train especially for long journeys as it gives me opportunity to meet new people and learn from them.
In this journey as well I met a person who came aboard at the Delhi junction.
He seemed like a really nice person and when I told him that we are going to Andaman Islands he said that last year he went to the same place.
He shared his experience and guided me about tourist attractions of the Islands.
He also suggested us about the hotels that we should consider for our accommodation and how to stay away from some of the unscrupulous travel agents who are always looking to hoodwink the tourists.
He travelled with us till Kochi where he alighted the train.
Nearly 5 hours later the train reached its destination from where we left for the Islands.
Andaman is like no other place I have seen in India.
It is an epitome of nature’s creativity, with hills on one side and vast expanse of sea beach on the other.
There is so much greenery and open spaces that I could not believe such a place could exist in this modern urbanized world.
The frenzy of urbanization has not yet touched this part of our nation and there are still tribes present there which are living in their orthodox lifestyle.
I met a few guys from these tribes and was really fascinated with their way of living.
I also learnt about a few of their traditions which we would find absurd but are an integral part of their existence.
Their diet is also absolutely different from what we normally have in our daily lives.
Their diet primarily consists of sea creatures, some of which I cannot even imagine to ingest.
I was really enthralled by this visit as I got to see a completely different facet of mankind and nature.
It was a whole new experience for me, something I would remember till my last breath.

sentences: Technology has made our lives as comfortable as ever.

Everything, from books to electronic gadgets are available on these sites and are delivered hassle free at our homes.
So far my experience with these sites have been very satisfactory.
But recently I underwent a harrowing incident by making a purchase from one of the biggest ecommerce sites in our country.
I had been planning to buy a new smartphone for quite a while so I searched it on the website and after reading plenty of positive reviews I ordered this phone.
While making the purchase I particularly checked the return policy for this product and the website mentioned that it was returnable within 10 days of the purchase.
As usual the delivery was fast and smooth, I received the phone two days after placing the order.
For first couple of days I was happy with the phone as it was performing better than my expectation.
But on the third day it started getting really hot after playing any video for just ten minutes.
I thought it might be a one off case so ignored it initially.
But the issue persisted and I checked for it online.
A blog had mentioned that this issue was common with this model.
So I called the customer care of the website from where I bought this phone and told them that I want to return this phone as it had a major flaw.
To my surprise the customer care executive told me that I cannot return the phone but they can replace it with new handset.

But that was not going solve my problem because the issue was with all handsets of that particular model so I asked the customer care executive that why I could not return it especially if there website mentioned that the model was returnable within 10 days.
In reply he told me that because of the heating issue they are inundated with return request hence they had changed their policy from return to replace for this model.

I was utterly gutted by his response and felt completely cheated because the policy on which my decision to buy this phone was predicated was altered without any intimation and it had grave consequences for me as I had been delivered a below par product.

I argued with the executive and expounded my situation that it was unfair on their part to change the policy without informing the customers who had bought that product but he said that his hands were tied and he was unable to help me in this regard.
Subsequently I send some emails to the company as well but did not get any helpful revert.
Consequently I was stuck with that faulty phone.
After this terrible experience I decided never to buy any product from that website and also wrote a scathing feedback on their social media platform.

sentences: I have been blessed with some wonderful friends and some of the most cherished memories of my childhood are from the time I spent with my friends.

Every time we go to this mall we have a splendid time but our last visit was a rather a forgettable one and it was because of a horrendous experience we had in a Thai restaurant which had opened on that day only.
At the front door of the restaurant there was a board which said that the restaurant is offering 50% discount on all meals on its inaugural day.
So we decided to give it a try for two reasons, one was obviously the inaugural offer and the second reason was that none of us had tried Thai cuisine before.
So we thought it will be new and hopefully a good experience for all of us, but as things transpired lately it turned out to be one of the worst experiences of our lives.
We got in and settled on a table.
Since none of us had any clue about Thai cuisine so we asked a waiter to recommend us something good.
He said that we should order fish roll which was their specialty.
I specifically asked him that whether one dish would be sufficient enough for all of us since we all were famished.
The waiter assured us that one dish would easily cater to four of us and it would take just 10 minutes to prepare it.
We waited for 10 minutes nothing came, another 10 minutes passed and still no sign of our order.
So I got up went to the waiter who took our order, he apologized and said he would go and immediately come back with our food.
Another 15 minutes passed and he was nowhere to be seen, by now we all grew impatient and was about to leave in a sullen mood when the waiter came to our table with our order.
We were already in a very bad mood and things got worse when we had a look at the food tray.
The dish comprised only 5 small fish rolls each roll was at most 2 inches long.
Any one of us could have finished all rolls alone so there was no way it was sufficient for all of us.
When I asked the waiter about the quantity of the food, he plainly denied that I ever inquired about it.
One of my friends who has a short temper starting shouting but we asked him to cool down and just finish the meal and leave from there.
But the nightmare was not over yet.
We finished those paltry fish rolls and asked for the check.
When we received the check I observed that there was no discount offered and we were charged the full price of the meal.

I asked the waiter about the inaugural discount and he told me that in order to avail that discount we had to order for a minimum amount of 1000 rupees which apparently was mentioned in the fine prints of the advertisement which allured us to enter that restaurant in the first place.

That was the last straw and before our short tempered friend did anything which we might have regretted later I immediately paid the bill and asked my friends to leave and swore never to come back to that restaurant again.

sentences: I have been blessed with a great family.

My uncle is associated with a leading NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
When my uncle told my about this predicament I immediately volunteered to take science classes on that Sunday.
I made this decision to help my uncle but initially I was apprehensive as I did not have any teaching experience but I did not want to disappoint my uncle.
Still I shared my doubt with him and he told me not to worry a lot and promised me that I would love this opportunity.
And he proved to be exactly right.
I began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the plate.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO was doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.
He promised me that he would arrange something for me in the near future.

sentences: Both of my parents are working so I did not get much time from them in the childhood.

Every evening I would sit with my grandfather and he would share his experiences from his childhood and adulthood.
He told me several stories about how the time was different in his days and how much people have changed over the years.
There is one particular story that has stuck with me ever since I heard it for the first time.
It was an incident from my grandfather’s school days.
I remember this incident because it taught me few important things.
Once was the capricious nature of time that how it can change in a matter of days and second was the importance of family and hard work and persistence in our lives.
It was the year when he completed his higher secondary school.
In our education system higher secondary school is really crucial as its outcome decides the future course for any youngster.
Keeping this thing in mind he was determined to do well in that year, hence he started his preparation with utmost sincerity.
For the first half of the year everything was on track, as he did well in all the house tests and had covered bulk of the course, earmarking second half for revision.
However, it was around December when things started to go awry for me.
During a club cricket match he slipped and fractured his left ankle.
He was bedridden for a complete month because of which he could not attend his coaching classes where the revision batch had already started.
He started panicking because his final exams were only two months away.
And that is when his biggest pillar of strength, his family, helped him to go through that tough phase.
His parents settled his nerves and instilled the confidence in him that despite these setback he will live up to their expectations.
The fact that his family was beside him whatever the outcome really helped him to regain his focus.
Although he missed his coaching classes, but to make up for that he doubled his effort at home.
He kept abreast of everything happening in those classes through his friends.
After a month his plaster was removed and he regained his mobility but was still not able to travel on his own because of which he had to continue his self-study at home.
Exams came and went, and time just flew by, and then came the day of reckoning.
His result was out he had managed to score 95% the second highest in his batch.
His hard word had paid off and he would never forget the feeling of pride on the faces of his parents.

And second was that my favorite cricketer Virat Kohli who is the brand ambassador of Samsung was in that commercial.

The commercial started with Virat leaving from hotel for his practice session.
He took a cab and left for the ground.
When he reached the ground he forgot his phone in the cab which he did not realize until he had entered the ground and thought of calling his coach.
Normally under such circumstances a person would be flustered since he had lost a precious belonging.
But in the advertisement Virat is portrayed to be very calm while telling his team mate about his phone and the reason behind this calmness are the amazing features of this phone.

Firstly Virat tells his team mate that the phone can only be unlocked with his face ID and secondly he can easily trace his phone by simply giving a call to Samsung customer care from any other phone which he actually does in the commercial.
And within seconds Samsung’s customer care executive tells Virat about the location of his phone and also place a call on his number which is picked by the cab driver.
Once the cab driver realizes that his passenger had forgotten his phone in his car he goes back to the ground and hands over the phone to Virat.

The commercial ends on a very happy note in which Virat and cab driver are seeing taking a selfie from the same phone which has a 32 mega pixel front camera the highest resolution in any phone in the market.
I absolutely loved this commercial and the amazing features of the phone.
Next week I bought this phone and I cannot deny that the commercial played a huge role in this decision of mine.

In this regard my parents could not help me much because to make this decision I needed someone who kept abreast of latest developments in the field of education as well as career opportunities available after completion of higher study.
Fortunately I had someone with experience and credentials to guide me on this.
One of my uncle’s daughter recently graduated from a reputed college in Canada and immediately after completing her education got a job offer from a leading IT company.
When I approached her with my problem, she immediately asked me about my interests and my long term goal.
I told her about my predilection for technology and accordingly she adviced me to opt for non-medical stream for my higher study.
It was fine as far as my interest was concerned but then I inquired about career choices that I would I have if I chose non-medical.

I shared my apprehension with her and she acknowledged the fact that things have changed a lot in recent years.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.
Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at a port city from where the last mile to the island is covered by a ship.
I along with my family were sitting on a bench waiting for the train to arrive.
I was listening to music on my phone when it started ringing.
It was a call from an unknown number.
I picked up the call and on the other side I heard the sound of a man who sounded like a person in his thirties or forties with a very mature voice.
He asked if it was the customer care number of ANZ bank and I told him that he had got the wrong number.
Either he had the wrong information about the customer care number or it was a case of wrong connection.
I said politely that it was a wrong number and was about to disconnect the call when I discerned some panic in his voice.
Just out of curiosity I asked him what had happened.
He told me that he had lost his credit card and is now worried that it might be misused which would result in a substantial financial loss to him.
That is why he was trying to reach the customer care of the bank to get his card blocked immediately.
I told him that he could do it himself from his mobile phone which he was apparently not aware of.
I was not surprised because generally people in his age group are not very tech savvy and use their mobile phones primarily for calling and messaging.
He requested me if I would be kind enough to take him through the process of blocking the card on the mobile phone.
It was an easy process so I thought of helping him out because I knew he could do it if I guided him properly.
So I told him to first install the mobile application of the bank if it was not installed already.
He told me that it was there on his phone, once I knew this, the rest was a matter of few clicks.
Next I told him to open the app and go to security settings.
He did that and asked me for the next step.
Then I told him to look for block/ unblock card options in that settings which he found immediately and knew what to do next because it was quite obvious from the name of the option.
He checked the box against block card option and immediately got an SMS saying that his credit card had been blocked.
He thanked my profusely and told me that I was a life saver.

I told him that it was not that big a favour and then I heard the siren of the train which signaled that our train was arriving at the station so I told him that I had to leave at which moment he again thanked me and wished me best of luck for my life endeavors.

sentences: I am a gregarious person and like to meet new people.
I believe interacting with different individuals helps me to grow as a person and gives me a new perspective on several aspects of life.
The best occasions to accomplish this are the social events such as family functions.
I always look forward to invitations to these functions and it is very rare that I let go of these opportunities.
Last week also I got an invite to the birthday party of my nephew.
I am always eager to attend such parties but unfortunately this event did not turn out to be a joyful experience for me.
The scheduled time for the party was 6 pm so it reached there by 6.15 pm and to my surprise I was the first person to reach there, not even the hosts had yet arrived there.
I called up my cousin and he said that they are on their way.
Since I was alone till their arrival I was already bored and feeling a bit low.
Finally the host and other guests started to arrive.
I was hoping to see some familiar faces with whom I could interact and have some interesting conversation.
The party started at 7 pm and celebrations included cake cutting and some performances from my nephew and his friends.
Though I enjoyed their acts I was still feeling bored because most of the guests that had gathered at the party were unknown to me and I could not find a single person with whom I could talk.
Actually majority of the guests comprised of my cousin’s office friend and the parents of my nephew’s friends.

He did invite few of our relatives and that was the primary reason I was looking forward to this event because I had not met some of them for quite a long time and it would have been the perfect opportunity to catch up.
But our relatives could not attend the event because of some prior commitments they had.
When my cousin informed me that our other relatives were not coming I immediately knew that the evening is going to be drag for me.
Though he tried his best to keep me entertained and occupied but he had other guests to attend to so I told him that he should focus on other guests and I would be fine.
With nothing much to do and nobody to talk to I picked up my phone and started shooting videos of my nephew doing his kid stuff.
And that was the only good thing that happened to me on that evening.
Later I showed the videos to my cousin and he too enjoyed and thanked me because he missed all those small moments since he was busy entertaining the guests.

My father is an avid football fan and when I was a kid I used to enjoy watching football matches with him.
During that short span of time my father would transform into a completely different person.
He is deeply passionate about very few things and football is one of these things, and I inherited that passion from him.
I started playing football in the small park which is situated in the middle of our society.
Most of the boys in my society are of my age so it was not difficult to find company for the sport.
We formed a small group and every evening played football for nearly 2 hours.
The game brought us really close and we started enjoying each other’s company even after play time was over.
I think this feeling of togetherness is inherent in the sport since it is a team sport.
I particularly remember one game in which things go really close.
It was the final of our society football club competition and my team was one of the finalists.
The scores were tied at 2-2 in the first half and no team managed to score another goal in the regular time in the second half.
We were given an extra time of 15 minutes at the end of regular time.
Every player on the field was tense and giving him 100 percent to win the match for his team.
Since I played in the offence it was my responsibility to score the winning goal for my team and that day I was hellbent to do it.
Luckily in the last minute of the game I got a clear pass from our team’s midfielder and I managed to turn that pass into a goal.
My whole team was ecstatic because this was the time we had won this competition.
The feeling after winning was like no other feeling I had experienced before.
After the official ceremony, the whole team went out to celebrate our victory.
It is still one of the most memorable days of my life.

sentences: My grandparents live in Delhi and both are above 70 years of age.
Last year in November my maternal uncle called my mother and gave her an unfortunate news that my grandfather had suffered a stroke and his condition was critical.
After hearing this news my father immediately booked train tickets that were available at that time.
The train was scheduled to leave at 5 am in the morning but due to winter it was foggy early morning so the train could not leave on time.
Due to heavy fog and to avoid any untoward event the departure was delayed by one hour.
When the conditions finally got better and visibility improved the train left the station.
My mother was worried during the entire journey and me and my father were trying to console her and tell her that everything would be alright.
Although she feigned the feeling of being calm but we knew that deep down she was terrified because stroke is a serious ailment.
Normally the train we took travels at an average speed of 80 km per hour but due to foggy conditions the train could not pick up speed and moved at a much slower speed.
The conditions remained like that till 10 am and till that time train travelled at a slower speed.
Under normal circumstances the train reaches its first stop at the city of Indore from our city in 2 hours but on that day, it took 4 hours to reach Indore.
We knew that we were going to be late so we called my uncle about that and told him that when we enter the city of Delhi, we would call him again so that he could come and pick us up.

While my father was apprising him about the delayed journey my uncle gave us a very good news that the condition of my grandfather had stabilized and the clot which had formed in his brain due to stroke had been dissolved with medication.
The prognosis of the doctor said that there was no major impact of this stroke on my grandfather and he should be able to recovery quickly and resume his daily life routine with no impairment.
That news came as a huge relief for all of us but my mother was still worried and wanted to see her father as soon as possible.
Finally we reached Delhi 5 hours late.
My uncle was waiting at the station.
My mother immediately hugged him and broke down in tears and then my uncle told her not to worry because everything was alright and my grandfather was conscious now.
All the reports and scans showed no serious damage to his brain and all his senses were working normally.
We left straight for the hospital and my grandmother was waiting for us there.
She looked tired but the sight of her daughter brought a smile on her face.
Then she told us about everything, how and when it all happened.
While she was having this conversation, the doctor came and said that we could now see my grandfather.
All of us immediately went to his room and were delighted to see him alright.
After that my uncle and my father talked to the doctor about future course of action.
He told about the medication that were prescribed to my grandfather and some precautions that needed to be taken.
He said that they would further keep him under observation for another 24 hours and if nothing of concern happens then they would discharge him.

We spend another 3 days at my grandparents’ home before returning back.

sentences: For any individual life is a journey which is full of surprises.
Every individual’s life has some moments which he or she cherishes forever and some moments which are not so memorable.
My life has been no different but fortunately I have had more great moments than not so great moments.
Although it is difficult to pick one particular happy moment from my life because there have been so many, there is one particular experience which I will savour forever.
This whole experience started with a short SMS which I have saved till date.
It was the year when I completed my higher secondary school.
In our education system higher secondary school is really crucial as its outcome decides the future course for any youngster.
It lays the foundation of a bright career.
Keeping this thing in mind I was determined to do well in that year, hence I started my preparation with utmost sincerity.
For the first half of the year everything was on track, as I did well in all the house tests and had covered bulk of the course, earmarking second half for revision.
However, it was around December when things started to go awry for me.
During a club cricket match I slipped and fractured my left ankle.
I was bedridden for a complete month because of which I could not attend my coaching classes where the revision batch had already started.
I started panicking because my final exams were only two months away.
And that is when my biggest pillar of strength, my family, helped me to go through that tough phase.
My parents settled my nerves and instilled the confidence in me that despite these setback I will live up to their expectations.
The fact that my family was beside me whatever the outcome really helped me to regain my focus.
Although I missed my coaching classes, but to make up for that I doubled my effort at home.
I kept abreast of everything happening in those classes through my friends.
After a month my plaster was removed and I regained my mobility but was still not able to travel on my own because of which I had to continue my self-study at home.
And then I finally appeared in my board exams.
Exams came and went, and time just flew by.
And then came the day of reckoning when I received an SMS from my school that I can check my result on its official website.
My result was out and I would confess that I was not so confident about my performance, but when I saw my result on school’s website I was on cloud nine.
I had managed to score 95% the second highest in my batch.
My hard word had paid off and I will never forget that feeling of pride on the faces of my parents which easily makes it the greatest moment of my life so far.

sentences: I have always been fascinated by technology and the way it has transformed our lives.
I keep abreast of all the latest developments in the field of technology and regularly read science journals and articles.
There is another tradition that I follow religiously and that is to visit the Science Expo that takes place every year in the month of June in my city.

The Expo provides the opportunity to all major IT companies to showcase their latest products which are based on cutting edge technology and for technology buff like me it is the best opportunity to see and experience these astonishing products live.
This year also I visited the expo with the same zeal and enthusiasm but this year I had a specific purpose in mind.

I was looking to buy some gadget that would help my mother in her daily household chores because I knew the pain she goes through everyday to keep all of us happy and satisfied to I wanted to thank her in my own geeky way.
The moment I entered the arena it felt like a whole new world something from the sets of a sci-fi movie.
I explored the cabins of almost all the companies and were highly impressed by their latest offerings.
But there was one product which caught my imagination at the very first glance.
It was a 5 feet tall robot which was welcoming and greeting the audience in a very traditional way which almost felt human.
It got me intrigued and went to know more about that robot.
The robot was the latest humanoid invented by the company Humans of Future, a renowned name in the field of artificial intelligence.
They handed me the brochure which apprised me of the latest platform the robot was based on and all the major functions that it could perform.
The robot was priced at USD 300 which gave it the tag of the most expensive product in the expo.
But the team explained in detail that why their product commanded such hefty price and why it was worth every penny.
They told me that the robot can do all the basic chores that we do daily in our homes.
It could do dusting, cleaning, washing dishes and clothes and could take out the trash and put in the bin outside our home.
And that was the moment when I realized that I have found what I was looking for, I had already made up my mind to buy it but still wanted to know more about it just out of curiosity.
The team further explained that it was equipped with a highly efficient communication system and could understand all the basic instructions from a human.
They told me give it a try so I asked the robot to bring me a glass of water from the nearby water dispenser.
To my surprise it did not only brought me glass of water, it also asked me if I would like a refill after finishing the glass.
I was simply dumbfounded by the level of intelligence the robot possessed.

This was by far the most amazing piece of technology I had ever bought in my life and it made me realize that artificial intelligence in not arriving rather it has already arrived and the day is not far when it will become a regular part of our lives.

When I showed it to my mother her first reaction was that I had gone crazy to buy something so expensive but after explaining her everything and demonstrating the activities the robot could perform my mother got excited and her eyes were filled with tears.

sentences: In my country the population has been growing at a steady rate.
More number of individuals means more facilities required for their survival including housing spaces.
Due to increased demand for residential spaces there has been a significant decline in green areas.
While the cutting down of trees has been indiscriminate, there is one plant which has recently come into great demand and people are actually planting it in their backyard gardens.
The plant is of kiwi fruit.
Few years back not many people had heard of this fruit.
But it suddenly shot to popularity when its medicinal property to fight the disease of dengue was discovered.
Every year during the period of September-october dengue fever spreads to certain parts of my country.
During that period it becomes an epidemic.
This happens because weather in that period is opportune for breeding of mosquitoes.
No doubt government authorities and people take certain precautions as they are well aware of its danger even then the disease spreads to considerable levels.
The most fatal effect of dengue fever is that it leads to a decline in count of white blood cells in the patient’s body which weakens his immune system and makes him vulnerable to serious infections.
This is where kiwi has proved to be highly effective.
It has been scientifically proven that ingestion of kiwi helps the body to generate new white blood cells which strengthens his immune system.
Hence it is a life saver for the patients of dengue.
Whenever someone is diagnosed with dengue the doctor immediately prescribes him to start taking this fruit.
The fruit has other therapeutic effects as well.
It contains high amount of fibre, so it also helps to improve digestive system.
The fruit is very easy to plant and grow that is why it is becoming a household item.

sentences: I am a hyper active person.

I picked up the sport from my father.

I have read his biography and seen his biopic as well which is titled ‘Pawn Sacrifice’.
The movie is primarily based on the epic chess encounter which happened between him and the Russian Grandmaster Borris Spassky who was the best chess player at that time.
The fifth game of this encounter is considered to be arguably the best game of chess ever played.
I particularly like chess because the things we learn from chess are not meant just for the game.
It teaches us how to plan in advance and make calculated moves in like just like in the game.
It also teaches us the patience and the will required to handle unpredictable circumstances of life when our opponent in the game makes a move which we are expecting the least.
I would say everybody should play this game once in a while because it helps immensely in the overall development of personality of an individual.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveler.
Every weekend I make sure that I go to some place where I can spend some time in solitude.
Normally I prefer going to hilly areas which are at most 100 miles away from my city hence are a convenient destinations for a weekend.
Although these destinations are easily accessible by public transport I always travel in my car as it gives me a lot of flexibility in terms of time and planning.
Last month as well I had one such trip to Mareena Hills.
Generally these trips are very refreshing for me but this particular trip was a forgettable one and the reason was my car which broke down on my way to Mareena Hills.
Normally before leaving I check everything and make sure that my car is in perfect condition in terms of fuel, air and battery.
But this time I forgot to check for spare tyre, the lack of which caused me a lot of trouble.
When I was just 20 miles away from my destination, the front left tyre of my car got punctured.
Initially I was not really flustered because I know how to replace a flat tyre but when I opened the boot of my car I was dumbfounded as I could not see the spare tyre.

Then it crossed my mind that two days ago I went to drop my brother to the airport for his flight to London and to accommodate his luggage in my car’s boot I took out the spare tyre and kept it in the garage which I later forgot to put back.
To make matters worse this incident happened when the night was approaching.
And I knew that at that time there would not be many people travelling on that route so I was not really hopeful of any immediate help.
First I thought of walking for a mile to check if there was any gas station from where I could get a mechanic to fix the tyre.
But I was apprehensive about leaving the car alone at that time so I decided to wait for a while hoping that someone could come and extricate me from this situation.
Fortunately about 15 minutes later a car came by which was headed to the same destination.
The driver of the car saw me standing alone in the dark in front of my car.
He immediately realized that something was wrong and I needed help.
He stopped his car there and came out to ask me about what had happened.
I told him everything and he said there was no need to worry, there was a car mechanic nearly 500 meters away and he would go and get him to fix my car.
After that he left and within 10 minutes he was back with the car mechanic.
The mechanic had brought everything needed to fix the puncture which he did.
Then I turned to the stranger whose name is Mark and told him that he was a life saver for me.
We exchanged our mobile numbers and I told him that if ever he needed any help he could call me without any qualms.
After this harrowing experience now I keep a checklist which I always go through before leaving for a journey.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.
Given the huge amount of distance, the most preferred way to travel to these islands from my city is either train or aircraft.

Since the aircraft tickets are really expensive in holiday season due to heightened demand, my parents decided to commute by train which terminates at Kochi from where the rest of the journey to the island is covered by a boat.
I was really excited for the trip apart from the one thing that the train leaves from my city at 5 am in the morning.
I am a night person and I generally go to bed at midnight and wake up around 8 in the morning.
My routine is pretty much regular and fixed so on that day I knew it was going to be bothersome for me because in order to catch a train that leaves at 5 am I had to wake up at around 3 am.

Normally I set my own alarm and I do not ask anybody to wake me up in the morning but the night before the day of our journey I specifically asked my mother to wake me up at 3 am because I knew that because of my routine I might not be able to get up on my own, even though I had set the alarm clock at 3 am.
And so it happened the alarm went off at 3 am and I had no clue whatsoever.
I was in a deep slumber and after hearing the sound of my alarm my mother came and woke me up.
My initial reaction was not to get up because I was feeling so dizzy and casually told my mother to go with my father and sister and leave me at home.
My mother knew that I needed something stronger than a casual nudge so she shook me as if an earthquake had come and told me to get up and get ready as soon as possible.
I clearly heard my father shouting from the other room that I better hurry up or we would miss our train.
The moment I heard my father’s words I immediately got up and started to get ready.
In the next half hour we were all ready to leave.
A day before my father had booked a cab to pick us up at 3.35 am.
The driver was right on time.
We sat in the cab and the station is an hour’s drive away from our place.
The moment I sat in the cab I went back to sleep.
Exactly an hour later we reached the station and my father woke me up and I behaved as if I had just gone to sleep a few minutes back in my own room.
It was really tough for me on that day to get up so early but I soon forgot everything because the rest of the trip to the Islands was just amazing and I savored every moment of that.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.
The islands are nearly 2000 miles away from my city.

I looked around frantically for it but could not find it.

I started panicking and was about to cry when my father calmed me down.

We went to the department and when informed the official there about the missing mobile, he immediately made an announcement through his mic which was played all over the railway station.
He said in the announcement that if anybody had found a Samsung Note 10 mobile anywhere on the station then please report it to the ‘lost and found’ department.
After the announcement he told us to wait for 15 minutes.
I was getting really impatient and angry at myself.
After nearly 20 minutes a gentleman came to the department and inquired about the announcement of missing mobile over the counter.
The man over the counter informed the official who made the announcement about this gentleman and brought him to his room.
I could see him carrying my mobile and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He handed over the mobile to the official who confirmed with me whether it was my mobile.
I was overjoyed to see that my mobile was in perfect condition and thanked the gentleman profusely.
He told us that he found the mobile in men’s washroom where it was lying behind the dustbin.
Then I realized that I might have dropped it when I went to the washroom before entering the waiting room.

sentences: Today’s era is the era of technology.
Technology is the cornerstone of everything today and there is no sphere of life that has not been touched by technology.

It is proliferating in the lives of people at a startling pace and one of the main reasons behind this phenomenon is the ease of availability and affordability of gadgets like smartphones which keep a person connected virtually to the entire world constantly.
One such technological platform that has enhanced the connectivity among people is the social media.
Today billions of people are using several popular social media platforms like Facebook, Whatsapp, Instagram etc.

While these platforms have brought people closer and have made exchange of information really convenient, there are times when some unscrupulous elements of the society use these platforms for their own selfish motives by spreading slanderous and false information on these platforms.
One such incident is still fresh in my memory as I too nearly was allured by an incorrect piece of information which I received on one of my Whatsapp groups.
One of my friends forwarded a message which purportedly claimed that an MLA of our city had made some derogatory remarks about a particular religious community.

The message came with an image in which MLAs’ face was shown in a very aggressive mood and a text box was pasted near his face in which an unacceptable statement was written about that particular religious community.
The text box was pasted in a manner as if to portray that the MLA had spoken those words.
The message became viral and created a furor in our city.
Police immediately took control of the situation and started investigation into the matter.
The people of the community who were mentioned in that message were infuriated and called for the immediate arrest of the MLA.
The police ensured them that the law will take its course and if the MLA is found guilty he would be brought to the book.
The investigation started and the first thing that came out was that the image of the MLA in the message was taken 5 years back in one of his election rallies.
The MLA came out publicly and proved this fact and said that he would never do anything that would hurt the feelings of any community irrespective of their allegiance.

Further investigation revealed that the message was actually framed by a person who belonged to the opposition party and wanted to malign the image of the MLA who was gaining popularity because of his good deeds that he had done for our city.
That person confessed his transgression and apologized to the community defamed in the message.
This was a classic case of misuse of technology and how easy it has become to spread false information which can culminate in grave repercussions.
The onus is completely on us, the users of technology to ensure that we do not fall prey to such incorrect pieces of information which unfortunately are shared without any qualms.

sentences: I am a happy go lucky type of person and my life has been full of memorable moments.
But no individual can claim that he has never faced a tough situation in his life and I am no different.
I too have been through some rough patches but there was one occasion recently when I was overly concerned to the extent that it got me scared.
I vividly remember it was the time of February.
Every year this time around the likelihood of diseases like dengue and malaria increases because of high breeding of mosquitoes.
Thousands of people catch these diseases and this year I was one of those unfortunate victims.
It started with a mild fever and body ache.
When it persisted for few days and decided to get myself checked.
When I explained my symptoms the doctor straight away wrote some tests for my fever as he feared the worst.
Reports came and I was diagnosed with dengue.
I was horrified because the images of my cousin came to my mind who had caught this fever two years ago.
He was completely bedridden for one month and the weakness caused by the fever emasculated him physically.
He lost over 5 kgs of weight and suffered severe hair loss.
He was almost unrecognizable after a month.
All these memories of his fueled my fear.
I was obviously fretting for my health but there was one more reason which exasperated my worry.
And that was my house tests which were scheduled to happen next month.
I was afraid that I would not be able to perform well in those tests if the fever worsened further.
But luckily it was caught at a very nascent stage and the doctor started my medication immediately.
I was administered the prescribed medicine for dengue along with glucose drips and appropriate diet.
I started showing signs of recovery after 3 days and 7 days later fresh tests declared me cured of this disease.

Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.

sentences: Every year I go to some holiday destination with my family in summer vacations.

In the summer vacations of the last 5 years we have explored all the major hill stations in our part of the country.
I have a predilection for hilly areas as being a resident of a metro city I seldom get to see such beautiful sites full of greenery and fresh air.
Although there are couple of more hill stations which are on my bucket list, this year I went to a place which turned out to be the most unusual and most exciting trip of my life.
Two months back my cousin’s family went to Andaman Islands.
I checked his photos on facebook and in those photos the place looked attractive.
But when he came back and detailed me about the place, it really got my curiosity awakened.
So I talked to my parents about visiting the Islands and booked the train tickets to Kochi.
The journey by train takes nearly two days to finish which terminates at Kochi from where the last mile to the Islands is covered by a ship.
The moment I got off the ship I realized that Andaman is like no other place I had seen in India.
It is an epitome of nature’s creativity, with hills on one side and vast expanse of sea beach on the other.
There is so much greenery and open spaces that I could not believe such a place could exist in this modern urbanized world.
The frenzy of urbanization has not yet touched this part of our nation and there are still tribes present there which are living in their orthodox way.
I met a few guys from these tribes and was really fascinated with their way of living.
I also learnt about a few of their traditions which we would find absurd but are an integral part of their existence.
Their diet is also absolutely different from what we normally have in our daily lives.
Their diet primarily consists of sea creatures and my cousin had shown me pictures of their meals which had sea creatures which I could not even imagine to ingest.
I was really enthralled by this visit as I got to see a completely different facet of mankind and nature.
I was absolutely enchanted by the beauty of the Islands and loved to experience it firsthand.
On top of that I had never seen a beach before so this visit also helped me to cross another item off my bucket list.

sentences: Both of my parents are working so I did not get much time from them in the childhood.
Fortunately my grandparents live with us and it was them who practically brought me up.
They are sweetest grandparents one can have.
They fulfilled all my wishes in my childhood and sometimes my father would argue with my grandfather that he was pampering me by pandering to my demands.
Nonetheless he would continue to do so.
Every evening I would sit with my grandfather and he would share his experiences from his childhood and adulthood.
My grandfather was a clerk in one of the major banks in our country.
He got this job after clearing an entrance exam and two rounds of interviews.

On first day his job he went through an orientation process in which he and other new employees were apprised about the heritage of the bank and critical process that were entailed in the day to day running of the bank.
They were further explained their roles in the organization.
As a clerk my grandfather’s primary responsibility was to attend new customers who intended to open new accounts with the bank.
Everyday he would cater to nearly 50 customers and assist them in opening new bank accounts.
He would encounter different types of persons daily belonging to various age groups, religions, and educational backgrounds.

He told me that while it was easy to attend to literate people because they understood the process and information mentioned on the bank opening account form which was in English, he found it particularly challenging to open accounts for people with lower literacy level.

It was arduous because he had to explain the whole form to them and also to fill the form himself for them which consumed a lot of his time and sometimes other customers who were waiting in the queue got agitated because of this.

Nonetheless he really loved his work because he got the chance to meet people from different spheres of society and while doing the official those people would have a short chat with him and share their own experiences with him.
He particularly remember one such person who are nearly 70 years old and was not well educated.
When he arrived to open his account he came with a preconceived notion that all clerks in the banks are rude.
His notion was predicated on his prior encounter with an executive of another bank who was apparently abrasive to him because of his lack of knowledge of English.
But when he met my grandfather and was treated in very professional and polite manner by him, he was pleasantly surprised and also shared his previous bitter experience.
Then my grandfather explained to him patiently that not all bank employees are same and sometimes they behave rudely because of the pressure of the job.
That old person gave blessings to my grandfather and became a patron of the bank and also recommend many more customers to the bank.
He personally met the manager of the bank and praised my grandfather because of which he got employee of the month award.

sentences: Last year I went to Andaman Islands in my summer vacation.

I knew it was not going to be easy to spend two whole days in a train so I decided to carry some sources of entertainment with me.
My two favorite pastimes are reading and listening to music.

On the very first day of our trip I got bored of reading the book because I had been reading it for 2 two hours at a stretch since I had no other source of entertainment.

I thought of few options and since music is my other love I decided to buy an MP3 player.
I told this to my father and he happily agree to buy me an MP3 player.
So went to an electronics shop for our purchase.
The shop owner showed us variety of MP3 players of different brands but there was one gadget which caught my attention at the first glance.
It was a magnificent piece of technology, manufactured by Sony the pioneer in the field of music players.
I then asked the shop owner about the features of that particular MP3 player and had already made up my mind to buy it irrespectively.
He told me that the internal capacity of the player was 8 GB which was enough to store more than 2000 songs.
Transferring the songs was a cinch, I just had to plug in the player in the USB port of my laptop and copy paste the songs of my liking.
The battery life of the player was really impressive I just had to charge it for 3 hours after which I would give me a playback time of nearly 30 hours.
I was really amazed by the features that were embedded in such a small piece of technology.
I could sort songs by the names of singers, albums and duration of the song.
It also had the feature of marking songs as favorite which enabled me to easily find and play the songs which I liked the most.
All of these features were made easy to access with the help of a 5 inch touchscreen which was highly responsive and accurate.
It is easily the best buy I have ever made on any of my vacation trips.
Really the advancement in the technology never ceases to amaze me and this mp3 player was one such example of this phenomenon.

The team further explained that it was equipped with a highly efficient communication system and could understand all the basic instructions from a human.
They told me give it a try so I asked the robot to bring me a glass of water from the nearby water dispenser.
To my surprise it did not only brought me glass of water, it also asked me if I would like a refill after finishing the glass.
I was simply dumbfounded by the level of intelligence the robot possessed.

This was by far the most amazing piece of technology I had ever bought in my life and it made me realize that artificial intelligence in not arriving rather it has already arrived and the day is not far when it will become a regular part of our lives.

When I showed it to my mother her first reaction was that I had gone crazy to buy something so expensive but after explaining her everything and demonstrating the activities the robot could perform my mother got excited and her eyes were filled with tears.

In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

My life has been no different but fortunately I have had more great moments than not so great moments.
First of all I have been blessed with a wonderful family which has supported me throughout and is the primary reason behind most of the splendid moments in my life.
Although it is difficult to pick one particular happy moment from my life because there have been so many, there is one particular experience which I will savor forever.
It was the year when I completed my higher secondary school.
In our education system higher secondary school is really crucial as its outcome decides the future course for any youngster.
It lays the foundation of a bright career.
Keeping this thing in mind I was determined to do well in that year, hence I started my preparation with utmost sincerity.
For the first half of the year everything was on track, as I did well in all the house tests and had covered bulk of the course, earmarking second half for revision.
However, it was around December when things started to go awry for me.
During a club cricket match I slipped and fractured my left ankle.
I was bedridden for a complete month because of which I could not attend my coaching classes where the revision batch had already started.
I started panicking because my final exams were only two months away.
And that is when my biggest pillar of strength, my family, helped me to go through that tough phase.
My parents settled my nerves and instilled the confidence in me that despite these setback I will live up to their expectations.
The fact that my family was beside me whatever the outcome really helped me to regain my focus.
Although I missed my coaching classes, but to make up for that I doubled my effort at home.
I kept abreast of everything happening in those classes through my friends.
After a month my plaster was removed and I regained my mobility but was still not able to travel on my own because of which I had to continue my self-study at home.
And then I finally appeared in my board exams.
Exams came and went, and time just flew by.
And then came the day of reckoning.
My result was out and I would confess that I was not so confident about my performance, but when I saw my result I was on cloud nine.
I had managed to score 95% the second highest in my batch.
My hard word had paid off and I will never forget that feeling of pride on the faces of my parents which easily makes it the greatest moment of my life so far.

Last month I checked off this place too when my uncle’s family planned to visit it.
He had come to our place on 4 days long vacation and I was excited to hear when he told me a visit to Taj Mahal was part of his itinerary.
We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Agra, the city in which Taj Mahal is situated in 2 hours.
As expected there was a long queue of tourists outside the gates of Taj Mahal waiting to get inside and get a glimpse of this magnificent structure.
The security checks at the entrance were robust and everybody was getting frisked thoroughly.
Finally we went past security checks and entered an aisle where we were given shoe covers which prevent the floor of the building from getting dirty.
I had heard a lot about the beauty of this eighth wonder of the world and went there will a lot of expectations.
The moment I laid my eyes on it I was completely enchanted by the view in front of my eyes.
I had never seen anything so beautiful before.
The view was absolutely surreal.
The entire covering of white marvel gave it a heavenly look.
I had seen many historical monuments but the painstaking manner in which Taj Mahal is built is simply exceptional.
The whole construction of the building is symmetrical to the last detail.
Everything is just perfect.
The two pillars on either side of the main structure stand tall like royal guards.
There are two small rose gardens on either side of passageway that leads to the main building.
While crossing through that passageway it felt as if the royalties are still residing there.
The main building encompasses the tomb of the king who built this epitome of beauty.

I am still in awe of Taj Mahal and startled because I cannot fathom that how the workers of that era managed to build such near perfect structure without the help of any technology and mechanical gadgets.

This dish is called butter chicken.
Majority of north Indians are non-vegetarian hence chicken is widely used on the special occasions.
Although there is plethora of dishes which are prepared using chicken, butter chicken has become a symbol of joyfulness.
As the name suggests the main ingredient is chicken, but what make this dish special are the spices which embellish this dish.
The preparation of the dish is an open secret and is often served in all north Indian restaurants.
The main advantage of this dish is that it can be eaten with both chapatti and rice.

sentences: India is country with rich heritage.
Our country’s history is full of folklores and marked by events that changed the course of history.
I have a keen interest in the history of our country and would love to learn more about it, particularly the period of struggle for independence.
I have read a lot about in our history books that how India became a colony of The East India Company and how the movement for freedom started.
The East India Company landed on the shores of India in the 17th century under the pretense of trade with Indian merchants.
What began as a trade soon became an invasion and before anybody could realize India became a colony of Britain.
The East India Company deployed divide and rule policy to undermine the unity of Indian states.
The infighting between Indian states was unduly exploited by the company.
While the princely states were engaged in fighting with each other, the company slowly and gradually gained control over smaller provinces and critical administrative functions of the country.
Once the company monopolized administrative functions it was a matter of time that the whole country became their property.
The company ruled over India for 200 years without any real resistance because they managed to manipulate the rulers of several Indian states for their own benefits.
But in 1857 the mutiny against British rule was ignited by a small yet a highly significant event in the context of India’s fight for freedom.
A small group of traders were forced by the company’s merchants to use bullet covers that were made from animal skin.
Since it was against their religious belief so they were resisted it which led to a skirmish between the traders and British soldiers.
After this event the fight for freedom gained the impetus which it lacked before.
In the following years many prominent leaders emerged and led this movement for freedom.
Like other revolutions, India’s revolution was also marked with some extremely gory events in which many people sacrificed their lives for this cause.
On the other end of the spectrum there were legends like Mahatma Gandhi who believed in the concept of non-violence and fought this was with unwavering faith in this concept.
Finally on 15 August 1947 British agreed to relinquish control over India.

While these are only the highlights of India’s freedom fight, I am interested to know more about the freedom fighters like Bhagat Singh, Chandrashekhar Azad and many more who were the unsung heroes of this freedom struggle.

sentences: There are many respectable professions in our society like doctors, engineers, lawyers, government officers etc.

That profession is of stock traders.
I had seen couple of movies and series and was fascinated by their lifestyle portrayed in those depictions and dreamt of becoming a trader one day.
But a recent interaction disillusioned me and gave me a reality check of this field, after which I decided against become a stock trader.
After that interaction I came to know why people say ‘grass is always greener on the other side’.
This interaction happened with one of my cousins who recently joined an investment bank and handled the portfolio of one of the most affluent clients of the bank.
His main responsibility is to invest his client’s money in stocks for short duration for handsome returns or in simple terms he is a stock trader.

When I told him that I envy him and I am desirous of become a trader one day, he immediately told me to drop this dream and aim for some other profession as this profession is not as great as it looks from the outside.
He told me that the job of a stock trader is one of the riskiest jobs in the world and there is no such thing as piece of mind in this profession.
Although the perks are great but those are only guaranteed as long as you are making money for the client and your company.
The day you loose money you will be given a warning and on the second instance you will be handed the pink slip so the job security is non-existent in this field.

He further told me that one can earn a lot of money in this profession but he cannot really enjoy it because at every moment his mind is preoccupied with his existing trades and the trades he is going to make next day.
He apprised me that in this field there is no personal space or time.
He frequently gets calls from his clients in the middle of the night if any news related to his trade breaks out.
And since the stock markets of the world are interconnected this is practically a 24×7 job.
A negative development in the US can hurt the stocks in India pretty badly, therefore, a stock trader has to be aware of such things at all times.
After hearing about all the mental trauma a stock trader has to go through on daily basis I swore never to think again about picking up this profession.

sentences: Urbanization has hit all parts of India.
Because of lack of opportunities in rural areas, people are flocking towards cities.
No doubt this movement has empowered people to raise their standard of living and secure a stable livelihood, but simultaneously it has affected the environment of cities adversely.
More number of people living in a city means less open spaces which has hampered the aesthetics of cities.
Modern cities are not as beautiful as they used to be.
But there is one city which has managed to maintain its beauty among this frenzy of urbanization and that city is Meerpur.
It is one of the metro cities of India.
It was established in the year 1937 and was conceptualized by English architect Mr. Anderson.
It was the first city in India which was constructed in a planned manner with proper blueprints of the construction.
The whole expanse of the city is divided into 58 sectors.
Each sector was designed carefully keeping everything in mind including, the local population, amount of green spaces and future demand.
It is because of this well thought out planning, that the city has absorbed the migrants seamlessly without burdening the basic structure of the city.
The city has a lot of parks which have been kept outside of residential areas.
The roads are wide which allows the traffic to flow smoothly and seldom we see traffic jams on the roads.
There are plenty of trees on both sides of roads which give the city a fresh look.
On the west side of the city there is a huge temple of lord Shiva which simply adds to the attraction of the city.
Thousands of tourists every year visit this temple.
Unlike other metro cities, in Meerpur tourists are not hackled by unscrupulous elements of the society.
The greenery and lack of heavy traffic adds to their experience.
Two years ago Meerpur was awarded the best tourist destination in our state.
