sentences: I have had several memorable moments in my life.
But there is one occasion which I will always cherish for my entire life and that is when I got 92% marks in my senior secondary exams.
This achievement is special to me for two reasons.
First is the hardships that I went through just before the exam.
Two months before the exams I fractured my left leg and could not go to my coaching classes.
So I did all the study at home on my own and I am glad that my hard work paid off.
And the second reason is the celebration which I had after achieving this feat.
Actually the whole thing was planned by my family and they kept it as a surprise till the last moment.
I was not aware of any such event and they really succeeded to keep this whole event as a secret from me.
My result came out on Wednesday and on Friday my father said that all of us are going for shopping to get some basic stuff for the home.
So we left at around 6:30 pm in the evening and I had no inkling what was to ensue.
I was surprised when our car entered one of most popular restaurants of our city and my father parked the car there and told us to come out of the car.
I was really confused and asked my father that why had we come here and he told me that he had a brief meeting with one of his friends after which they would leave to do their shopping.
So all of us entered the restaurant and followed my father who walked towards a room titled family hall.
That particular moment still flashes in my mind, the moment we entered the room the whole room lit up and for a moment I could not see anything.
Then gradually things started to sink in and I could see all our close relatives, my friends and their parents in the family hall.
All of them were shouting congratulations to me and when I looked at my father I could see the pride in his eyes with a small tear.
Then I realized that this whole event had been planned by my family to celebrate my achievement of scoring 92% marks.
There was a cake as well with a candle in the shape of number 92 on top of it.
All my relatives came to me and congratulated me and told me how proud they were of me.
My friends’ parents also said the same thing to me and said that they were glad that their children had a friend like me to whom they could look up to.
That was the proudest moment of my life and by the look on the faces of my parents I could say that for them as well it was one of the best moments of their lives.
That day I realized the real importance of my family and thanked god for blessing me with such great parents.

sentences: I have an inquisitive nature and I am always eager to learn new things.

Learning new things not only improves our knowledge it also helps us to grow mentally as scientific research has proven that learning new skills keep our brain young by forming new connections in the brain.

But I for some reason developed a predilection for Spanish.

Most of the institutions there were set up by them including the colleges and universities, that is why the bulk of local literature is still in Spanish.
When I heard the natives speak Spanish for the first time, I immediately fell in love with the language.
The language has an uncanny charm which is hard to explain.

Driven by my passion to learn this language I have already started my research on sources which could help me to achieve this dream of mine.

sentences: Friends are like extended family.

He is my oldest friend and I know him since I was 3 years old.

The head coach of our school was impressed by his football skills and the acumen he possesses for the game.
He was confident that given the right guidance Arun can become a professional footballer.
And last year he came one step closer to realizing his dream.
Last year a leading sports network in collaboration with Manchester United organized trial across the country to scout for talented footballers who can potentially play at the club level.
Nearly 2 million children participated in these trials and only 10 were to be selected who would get the chance to go to the UK and train in Manchester United club facilities.
And I with great pride can say that Arun was among those 10 shortlisted children who went to the UK to train with professional staff of Manchester United.

While playing this sport every muscle of the body is involved which is good for overall physical fitness and the continuous coordination required with other teammates makes my brain more alert and sharp.

I was sitting in my living room with my sister and she is really fond of this program.
She played the program and insisted that I watch it because in this program contestants are asked to play some very interesting games and to showcase their talent.
Although it is a game show, I liked this program for entirely different reason, that is the humorous nature of the program.
Most of the contestants are serious competitors with genuine abilities but for me the other contestants who were just there for some air time were the highlights of this program.
These guys were really weird and funny and I had a blast while watching their performances on live TV.
There was this one guy who actually believed that he was the reincarnation of Jesus.
He told about several miracles that he had performed and told the judges that he was there to exhibit his ability to fly in the air.
He said that he would jump off a table and before hitting the ground he would be afloat in air.
He asked the organizers to arrange a table and some strange stuff like half cut apple and wet salt.
He required apple and salt to perform some rituals which were part of his miracle.
He sat there on the floor and started doing some crazy stuff like kissing the apple and murmuring in his mouth.
He was pretty serious about this stuff and really got the audience intrigued.
For a moment even I believed that this guy might pull off something out of the box.
The build up to the event was impressive and then came the moment of truth.
He climbed on the table and made some gestures in the air towards the sky.
Then he asked the audience to take the lord’s name and shout jump at which moment he would jump off the table.
Audience followed his orders and shouted jump and at the same moment he jumped in the air.
I had to say I was impressed by the height he covered in his jump but the next moment he fell flat on the floor with a sound of thud.
It took me a second to realize what had happened but after that I laughed like a deranged man.
I kept laughing for another two minutes and my sister thought I had gone crazy too just like the man on TV.
She told me to get hold of myself but the whole event was just too funny.

sentences: I have been blessed with an amazing family.
My parents have always made sure that their children have received the best comforts they could afford.

Last year it was my parents’ 25th wedding anniversary so I decided to gift them something which would not only make them happy but also show my love for them.
Deciding to give them gift was easy but what to gift was the hard part because I knew that no material commodity would give them the satisfaction which I wanted them to feel.
I was really hard pressed about selecting the gift and thought about it for days.
I was really confused and shared my conundrum with my friend Arun.
And I am glad that I did that because he suggested me something which immediately felt right to me and would solve both my purpose.

He said that I should prepared a collage of all the family photos which should include my parents’ marriage, their children’s childhood, all the family trips that we have made so far and enjoyed together.
I really liked this idea because I knew that this collection of photos would be reminiscent of all the great moments of my parents’ life and they would once again relive and enjoy these memories.
I had decided the gift but the next problem was how to prepared it because I did not know how to prepare a well crafted collage.
I could manage some photo editing but I wanted it to be perfect so I asked again my friend for help and he suggested me a website that prepares such collages online for their users.
He had used it himself and assured me that this website is the best in the field and their customer service is delightful.
So I opened that website and registered an account, immediately a chat window opened and one of their representative greeted me and asked what exactly I was looking for.
I told her everything about the collage and she immediately started helping me in preparing the collage.
First she understood all my requirements and asked me to upload all the photos which I wanted to be in the collage.
Then she showed me some their best templates which users generally use to prepared collages.
Although I liked those collages but I told her that I would like prepare my own template to give it a personal touch.

I was initially apprehensive while making this request because I knew that making a new template from scratch is a time consuming process and I was not sure that the executive would agree to this because of the time constraint which these people have.
But to my surprise she was more than happy to help me and both of us started preparing a new template for the collage.
The executive was extremely patient and accommodated all my requests while preparing the collage.

She implemented all the changes that I suggested, sometimes I requested multiple changes on a single photo but she was as calm as a monk and on top of that she recommended some changes from herself based on her experience which really enhanced the quality of the collage.

It took us around two hours to prepared the template and the final collage and during those two hours I never felt any kind of frustration in her voice or got the feeling that she was rushing to finish my request.
I regularly shop online and deal with all types of customer care executives but I can definitely say that this was the best experience I had in my life while shopping online.
After finishing the job she kindly asked if there was anything else I needed help with.
I thanked her from the bottom of my heart and shared my feeling of respect which I had developed towards her and their services and promised to recommend their website to as many people as possible.

sentences: I am a perpetual traveler.

I have seen nearly all the historically important places in the vicinity of my city but there was one monument which had been sitting on the top of my bucket list for quite some time.
That famous building was Taj Mahal.
Last month I checked off this place too when my uncle’s family planned to visit it.
He had come to our place on 4 days long vacation and I was excited to hear when he told me a visit to Taj Mahal was part of his itinerary.
We started our journey in the car at 6 in the morning and reached Agra, the city in which Taj Mahal is situated in 2 hours.
As expected there was a long queue of tourists outside the gates of Taj Mahal waiting to get inside and get a glimpse of this magnificent structure.
The security checks at the entrance were robust and everybody was getting frisked thoroughly.
Finally we went past security checks and entered an aisle where we were given shoe covers which prevent the floor of the building from getting dirty.
I had heard a lot about the beauty of this eighth wonder of the world and went there will a lot of expectations.
The moment I laid my eyes on it I was completely enchanted by the view in front of my eyes.
I had never seen anything so beautiful before.
The view was absolutely surreal.
The entire covering of white marvel gave it a heavenly look.
I had seen many historical monuments but the painstaking manner in which Taj Mahal is built is simply exceptional.
The whole construction of the building is symmetrical to the last detail.
Everything is just perfect.
The two pillars on either side of the main structure stand tall like royal guards.
There are two small rose gardens on either side of passageway that leads to the main building.
While crossing through that passageway it felt as if the royalties are still residing there.
The main building encompasses the tomb of the king who built this epitome of beauty.

I am still in awe of Taj Mahal and startled because I cannot fathom that how the workers of that era managed to build such near perfect structure without the help of any technology and mechanical gadgets.

sentences: Education lays the foundation of a decent life for any individual.
It should be a fundamental right for every citizen.
I have been blessed with a family who deeply believes in the importance of education and has made sure that I have the best education possible.
I was an above average student in my school and my favorite subjects were maths and science.
These two subjects are paramount for intellectual growth of an individual as these challenge one’s ability to think and learn.
Maths is particularly important because of the basic skills it teaches us such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
These skills help us perform every day basic activities such as planning our family budget, paying for things and services that we buy and many more.
While these basic skills are the cornerstone of any mathematical teaching, there is one particular skill which I found really interesting and useful.
It is the ability to calculate probability.
I was taught about the concept of probability in my elementary school.
Probability as the name suggests is the ability to calculate the likelihood of any event.
It is a highly complex skill to learn as it requires counterintuitive thinking to calculate probability of anything.
But once I learnt this skill I realized how important and useful it is.
If we think logically then every decision we make in our lives is driven by probability.
Our decisions always have choices to make and we should make the best choice for us.
Now how do we decide which choice is best for us.
This decision should be made on the basis of event that is most likely to happen and which is deciphered by using the concept of probability.
For example recently my father decided to buy a car for the family.
We had shortlisted two models from two different manufacturers but could not decide any further.
That is when I used my probability skills to make the final decision.
I gathered some data points about both the models such as service centres of each company, number of cars sold each year, number of accidents these two models were involved in.
Then I used these data points to figure out that which car is more likely to last long with low maintenance cost using the probability method I learnt in school.

sentences: A student’s success is predicated on several important factors.
Obviously the most important are the guidance of the teacher and the efforts of the student.

But there is one more factor which is unfortunately not given much importance and that is the place where someone studies and I am talking about after school study time.
Ideally a student’s study place should be serene so that the student can concentrate for long span of time without much distractions.
Luckily I have found one such place and that is our city library.
This place was recommended to me by my father.
He already had membership of the library so I did not have to go through the trouble of securing membership for myself.
The library has a comprehensive collection of books on all the major topics including science, maths, economics and literature.
Some of the books are exclusive there such as books on local history.
I read these books in my spare time and find these very fascinating.
My father has bought the premium membership because of which I get extra privileges in the library.
These include access to the computer section of the library where I search for information which I could not get in the books of the library.
Also I can borrow two more books than someone who has purchased the regular membership.
I have been going to this library for the last couple of months daily and study there for nearly three hours everyday.
I have also made some friends of my age there and we have formed a sort of study group.
We share everything with each other which we think would help in our studies.
The library is close to my home hence commuting is not a big problem for me.
One of my friends from the study group lives in my society only so we do a bike pool daily.
We take our bikes on alternate days to the library.
Ever since I have joined this library I have formed a brilliant study routine and it reflects in recent performance in school tests.

But for me the main attraction is the options that it provides me.
I am not a brand conscious person but I don’t mind wearing branded clothes either.

All the major clothing brands have their outlets in this mall.
Every time we visit these outlets we can easily find some offers running which allow us to make good purchases within our purchasing power.
We might not get the best of the lot but we always get decent clothes at reasonable prices.
I have already gathered a nice collection of clothes, shoes and some accessories, all thanks to the shopping mall.

sentences: Music is one thing I absolutely love and nothing excites me more than great music.
I have inherited this predilection for music from my mother who is a trained singer.
She started teaching me music from my childhood and made sure I participated in the school musical events.
I dream of becoming a professional singer one day and in order to accomplish that I have to take the path less taken.
There are two prerequisites to become a singer.
First is obviously the hard work that is required to hone my skills and second is a great launch pad which would help me to begin my journey as a professional singer.
I have already taken care of the former and for the latter I have the perfect thing in mind.
Every two years in my country a musical competition called ‘Star Singer’ is organized.
It is orchestrated by one of the leading TV channels and is judged by three of most prominent music composers of our country.
The aim of the competition is to scout for talented singers and present them to the nation’s audience.

I have a firm belief in my abilities but it is not going to be easy to partake in this competition because every year thousands of talented singers audition for this competition and only 15 are finally selected.

I have seen the selection rounds of previous editions on TV and some of the singers were really impressive but even they got rejected because judges were looking for a complete singer who not only can sing but also had a great stage presence.
In essence their search culminates with a performer.
When the final 15 are selected then each judge takes 5 singers under his tutelage.
They are trained by their mentors and are given a chance to perform every week.
Their performance is watched by the entire nation after which people are requested to vote for their favorite performer through SMS.
The contestant with the least number of votes is eliminated next week.
This process repeats until we have a winner of the contest.
The winners of previous editions have already become established singers.
That is why I would like to compete in this event and win it to fulfill my childhood dream.

sentences: Gone are the days when information was confined to libraries and experts only.
Today the whole world is connected and has become an open source all thanks to invention of Internet.
Now the knowledge pertinent to any field is just a click away.
And people are more than willing to share their knowledge and experiences on the internet.
I too have availed this amazing platform on several occasions to quench my thirst for knowledge.
I am taking IELTS because I intend to go to Canada for higher studies.
I want to pursue my higher studies in the field which is relevant to my study so far and which has brilliant career options after completion.
For that I need to choose the right institution and the right course which was a bit problematic for me because I am sitting so far away and there are so many colleges to choose from.
I knew the gravity of the problem because a wrong choice of college and course would put my whole professional life in jeopardy.
In pre-Internet era to make the right choice would have been an arduous task but today I can easily get access to all the information I need from the comfort of my room.
Firstly I searched for colleges that offer graduation courses in the field of computer science because that is my field of interest.
There is no dearth of colleges in Canada that offer this course, so the next step was to choose the best option for me.
The next criteria in the selection process was to check the faculty and facilities provided by these colleges.
So I perused the websites of these colleges and read about the qualification and experience of computer science faculty members of these colleges.

Apart from faculty, I was particularly searching these websites for information on alumni of these colleges because a strong alumni network means more connections in the industry and better chances to get job.
I read about established alumni members of each college and where they are placed right now because that gave me inkling about what kind of companies I can approach after completing my course.
Using these criteria I have shortlisted 10-12 colleges where I would like to pursue my higher studies.
Internet has not only assisted me in choosing these colleges but has also apprised me about the process of application.
I can directly approach these colleges and know about the requirements of admission.
This is particularly helpful because it can save me from the network of unscrupulous agents who cheat students in the name of assistance they vouchsafe for admission in these institutions.

sentences: Urbanization has hit Indian cities at a frenzied pace.
The cities are sprawling at unfettered rate and people from rural areas are flocking towards cities for better living.
This has led to an area crisis where per capita free space in cities is diminishing day by day.
The residential areas are proliferating and free spaces are dwindling at an alarming rate.
To make things worse the city life has become hectic and stressful so people need ways to vent out their frustration.
One of such ways is an open green space something like a community park in a society.
A huge green park in the middle of a society is a blessing in myriad ways.
There is one such park in our society and I go there twice a week and witness how this public facility helps people to improve their life quality.
The biggest contribution of this park in improving our life quality is by improving the quality of air that we breathe.
Our city, like other major cities is highly polluted.
In winters the pollution reaches hazardous levels and severely affects the health of the people of our city.

Everybody knows that the best way to purify air is by planting more trees, so the greenery of this park ensures that the air at least in our society is pure and fresh, and one can feel that freshness early in the morning in this park.
There are several other ways in which this park helps the people of our society to better their lives.
Youngsters and adults frequently come to this park for physical activities.
Children play their usual games such as football, cricket, badminton and adults take their morning and evening walks in this park.
Such activities enables these people to keep fit and healthy.
But the demography that benefits the most from this park is of elderly people who are retired or do not have regular activities to keep themselves busy.
The aged people of our society have formed a laughter club and every morning one can hear a group of people laughing like crazy while standing in the park.
This is called laughter therapy and has been proved highly beneficial for health scientifically.
Even in the evening these senior citizens sit together in the park and share their life experiences and reminisce over joyous moments of their lives.
Overall this park is a great public utility for all the residents of our society.

sentences: I am a hyper active person.
I like to keep myself busy both physically as well as mentally.
For my physical fitness I prefer games such as badminton and football, and for my mental growth I resort to reading.
But recently I indulged in an activity which vouchsafed me emotional satisfaction and a sense of achievement.
My uncle is associated with a leading NGO which conducts weekend classes for the children belonging to underprivileged section of society.
He has been part of this NGO for a decade now and when I was a child he sometimes took me to the camps conducted by this NGO.
Those childhood visits were for fun purpose only but my most recent visit was a work of responsibility.
Every second Sunday of the month, science classes are conducted for these students.
But last month the regular science faculty fell ill and he called in sick at the eleventh hour.
So my uncle asked me if I would be willing to take those science sessions for one day.
Initially I was apprehensive as I did not have any teaching experience but I did not want to disappoint my uncle since this was the first time he asked something of me.
Still I shared my doubt with him and he told me not to worry a lot and promised me that I would love this opportunity.
And he proved to be exactly right.
I began my session with a small round of introduction in which I learnt about those kids.
They told me about their family background and all the hardships their parents have to go through just to put food on the plate.

I was really taken aback by the plight of their families and realized how good a work this NGO was doing by imparting education to these kids which would give them a platform to do something better with their lives.
In this emotional exchange of experiences I nearly forgot that I was there to teach science, which I was reminded by one of the students only.

I went with a preconceived notion that those students would not be serious about their studies but to my surprise they not only showed utmost sincerity in the class, they also gave me a reality check with their deep understanding of basic concepts of physics and chemistry.
I was really impressed with their hunger to learn and ability to grasp concepts quickly.
Time just flew by and before I realized it was time to end the session.
I went in as a teacher but came out as a student, those interactions taught me something about our society which I was completely oblivious of.
It was one of the most memorable days of my life and I wanted to experience it again so I asked my uncle if he would allow me to do more such sessions.
He promised me that he would arrange something for me in the near future.

sentences: It is said that music is food for soul and I could not agree more.
The reason music has a universal acceptance is that there is music for every kind of situation and mood.
It transcends borders and races.
For me music is the biggest stress buster and my favorite pastime.

I have created separate playlists which solve different purposes such as one playlist is full of songs which help me to relax while there is a playlist comprising of some peppy songs which I switch on whenever I am feeling a bit low.
Although I enjoy different genres of music and there are quite a few songs which I have listened to umpteen times, there is one song in particular which is really close to my heart.
The song’s title is ‘In the end’ and it is composed by band Linkin Park, suffice to say it is my favorite band as well.
No other band has been able to resonate with youngsters like Linkin Park has.
Its lead singer Chester Bennington is a true youth icon.
For years this band struggled in obscurity and released many songs.
But it shot to popularity with its most admired song ‘In the end’.
I first listened to this song at a friend’s place.
It was him who introduced me to this band and insisted that I should listen to their songs because their songs were not run of the mill stuff.
And I am glad that the first song which I listened to was ‘In the end’.
The moment he played the song I knew I was listening to something unique.
The song begins with strange sounding music which has been created with the help of an instrument which is used exclusively by this band.
The music plays for around 15 seconds after which the tempo of the song picks up by introducing guitar and drum the two instruments without which rock music is inconceivable.
But the main highlights of the song are Chester’s husky voice and the lyrics of the song.
There is an aroma of enigma the way he sings.
And the lyrics of the song are philosophical in nature which is usually the manner the band’s songs are written.
The theme of the song is life and it revolves around the idea that life is a journey and in the end what matters the most is that how we have lived this journey.
In the end the outcomes don’t matter but what matters is whether we have enjoyed this journey or not.
Like this song other songs of the band as well have an interesting and encouraging take on life and that is why it is my favorite band.

sentences: I am an inquisitive person by nature.
I always have questions about everything and like to get to the bottom it.
I am not the one to take things on their face value and do not easily accept it if it do not make sense to me.
I often argue with my parents on several topics.
Sure I argue but I ensure that I do not cross the line by disrespecting my parents.
I particularly enjoy the discussion with one of my uncles who is a deeply religious person.
Whenever he comes to our place it is inevitable that a conversation would start between us around some religious topic and it would last for couple of hours.
These conversations are entertaining as well as enlightening.
Normally my uncle is not affronted by my questions about religion but there was one occasion when he was perturbed by my perception about religion and its role in the society.
I was arguing that religion has done more harm than good for the society because of all the negative propagandas that are promoted in the name of religion.
There is so much violence and cheating going around in the name of religion.
Unscrupulous elements of the society are hoodwinking the gullible people and exploiting their deep faith.
And when I suggested that may be world would have been a better place without religion he started casting aspersions on my core values and upbringing.
Had he questioned my thinking alone I would have countered it with my opinion that I have around religion.
But when he brought up the role of my parents it really disturbed me because I would never accept such a thing.
My first reaction was to challenge him strongly and aggressively but it was my parents’ upbringing that curbed my instincts.
My parents had taught me never to disrespect our elders.
I waited for him to calm down for couple of minutes and then asked him politely that he should not have questioned my parents’ method of bringing up their children.
He accepted that he went a bit too far and tendered an apology to me and my parents.
I told him that there is no need to apologize as everything happened in the heat of the moment.
But I am glad that I controlled my temper and showed forbearance when I easily could have reacted in a more impolite manner.

Initially the sound levels were unobtrusive but after a few days the volume grew louder and since he played it till late in the night, it interfered with my sleep.
I thought it might be one off case but when it continued for some days I decided to talk to his parents.
His parents seemed like nice people and assured me that they would talk to their son.
For few days things went back to normal but then he again started playing music loudly.
I again complained to his parents and this time they suggested that I talk to him in person because I might be in a better position to explain my trouble.

When I told him that his loud music had been really disturbing for me he sincerely apologized and assured that it will not happen again.
Since then he has not given me a chance to complain and we have become very good friends.

sentences: I have received several gifts from my parents and all those are special to me.
But there is one gift which I would remember for a long time.
This gift was given with a purpose and a lesson, which I did not realize at first.
On my 16th birthday my father gave me 5000 rupees.
He told me that I could do whatever I want with that money and asked me to think about it for a day and inform him about my wish the next day.
I was a bit a perplexed because firstly I was not expecting money as a gift and secondly the amount was really significant for a 16 year old.
My first thought was to buy the gaming console which I had been yearning for some time but I had suspected that my father had an ulterior motive behind such generosity.
So I gave a hard thought about what I should do with that money.
I thought about it all night but could not fix my mind on one thing.
So next day I talked to my father and told him about my indecisiveness.
He said that he would help me with that but first he would tell me that why he gave me money on my birthday.
So he told me that this gift was meant to teach me the importance of money and the habit of saving it.
My father had a humble background and was brought up with very limited resources at his disposal.
He has worked diligently throughout his life to establish himself and to ensure that his family has all the comforts which he could not get in his childhood.
His hardships has taught him the importance of money and he wanted me to learn this lesson at a very early age, hence this gift.
He told me that saving money is as important as earning it.
He gave me his own example, that how he has saved some amount every year for my higher education which would have been difficult to generate in a lump sum.
He also told me about his emergency fund in which he contributes a small proportion of his income every month for untoward events.
So he suggested me to open a bank account with the gift he gave me and to contribute to that account from my monthly pocket money.
I heeded his advice and since then have been depositing small amount to this account every month.

sentences: India is a land of rivers and lakes.
Every state in my country has its own networks of rivers and lakes.
All these rivers hold great significance in their respective states.
Some are important because these are associated with the mythology and some are important from economic point of view.
There is one river which holds a special place in the heart of every Indian and that is river Ganga.
It is the longest river in my country with a span of 2000 km.
It originates in the mountains of Himalaya and terminates by joining Indian Ocean in the bay of Bengal.
In Hindu mythology Ganga is not considered just a river, it is revered as a goddess.
There are many popular stories in which Ganga has been portrayed as a goddess and has been helping mankind since time immemorial.

It is a tradition among Hindus to submerge the remains of a dead person after cremation in Ganga because it is believed that by doing this the departed soul is accepted by god and hence rests in peace forever.
Ganga passes through more than 10 states in India.
In each state it is called by a different name and every state has its own story linked with Ganga.
But there is one common thing among all these states.
In every state there is one or two religious places of great significance located on the banks of Ganga.
While these shrines are primarily known for their religious importance, these have also become a great source of livelihood for the local citizens.
Because of their religious value these temples are visited by millions of pilgrims every year from all over India.
Such heavy footfall has turned these places into great tourist spots.
Tourism has generated employment for local citizens and has helped them to raise their standard of living.
Ganga has touched the lives of millions of people in my country and has contributed in some way or other positively.
I just have one concern and that is the growing contamination of Ganga because of some human activities.
Our government has taken note of it and has taken appropriate measures to keep our holy river clean.

For a football enthusiast that was once in a lifetime opportunity to meet his living idol and get the chance to interact with him in person.
Function began in the customary manner with a prayer followed by cultural activities.
Normally I would enjoy these activities but that year my mind was preoccupied by the event to follow.
Finally the time came when our principal invited Arun Kumar on the stage and felicitated him with a memento.
Then he requested the football captain to address the audience with a short speech.
He began his speech with a quote from Mahatma Gandhi and told us that he idolized him for his humility and simplicity, the traits that he himself epitomized.
Then he shared his childhood experiences and how he struggled in the process of becoming a professional footballer.
He belonged to a middle class family and like in an orthodox family the focus was primarily on studies and sports were only considered as leisure time activity.
But he always had more interest in sports and dreamt of representing our nation in the sport of football.
When he first shared his ambitions with his father, understandably there was some resistance.

But his father had always believed in following one’s passion so he agreed to support him in his decision but with one condition that he had to ensure that his studies would not suffer because of his involvement in the sports, a criteria which he managed to meet.
But that was not the end of his hardships.
At that time football was not a lucrative sports option so the basic infrastructure for the sport was very limited and rudimentary.
There was only one playground big enough to practice football but it was 10 miles away from his home.
So every day he rode his bicycle 10 miles to and fro for his practice which was highly demanding especially after practice when he was completely exhausted physically.
But this daunting task did not deflated his spirits.
He continued this routine for 5 years till the point when he was spotted by district football coach.
He recognized the potential in him and requested his parents to allow him to shift to the state football academy.
This move was particularly tough for him emotionally as he had never lived away from his family.
Nonetheless he relocated and things got even more difficult as in the academy he faced tougher competition from players all over the state.
But this competition made him even more resolved and he doubled his efforts to realize his dream.
The rest as they say is history.

This short speech of his reinforced the notion in my mind that no matter how humble your beginning is and how many obstacles you face, if you are determined and persevere then you can surmount any hurdle in your life.

sentences: For any individual life is a journey which is full of surprises.

First of all I have been blessed with a wonderful family which has supported me throughout and is the primary reason behind most of the splendid moments in my life.
Although it is difficult to pick one particular happy moment from my life because there have been so many, there is one particular experience which I will savor forever.
It was the year when I completed my higher secondary school.
In our education system higher secondary school is really crucial as its outcome decides the future course for any youngster.
It lays the foundation of a bright career.
Keeping this thing in mind I was determined to do well in that year, hence I started my preparation with utmost sincerity.
For the first half of the year everything was on track, as I did well in all the house tests and had covered bulk of the course, earmarking second half for revision.
However, it was around December when things started to go awry for me.
During a club cricket match I slipped and fractured my left ankle.
I was bedridden for a complete month because of which I could not attend my coaching classes where the revision batch had already started.
I started panicking because my final exams were only two months away.
And that is when my biggest pillar of strength, my family, helped me to go through that tough phase.
My parents settled my nerves and instilled the confidence in me that despite these setback I will live up to their expectations.
The fact that my family was beside me whatever the outcome really helped me to regain my focus.
Although I missed my coaching classes, but to make up for that I doubled my effort at home.
I kept abreast of everything happening in those classes through my friends.
After a month my plaster was removed and I regained my mobility but was still not able to travel on my own because of which I had to continue my self-study at home.
And then I finally appeared in my board exams.
Exams came and went, and time just flew by.
And then came the day of reckoning.
My result was out and I would confess that I was not so confident about my performance, but when I saw my result I was on cloud nine.
I had managed to score 95% the second highest in my batch.
My hard word had paid off and I will never forget that feeling of pride on the faces of my parents which easily makes it the greatest moment of my life so far.

sentences: I am a very well organized person and truly believe in executing a task in a very diligent and painstaking manner.
Because I believe it is better not to do a task rather than making a desultory attempt.
For me planning is the most important part of any task and it is rightly said that well begun is half the job done.
So it is paramount that we understand and plan the things in advance before embarking on any endeavor.
For me before taking up any task I always do a SWOT analysis.
SWOT stands for strength, weakness, opportunity and threat.
The four terms are self-explanatory.
Every time I am to start a new job I first analysis my strengths and comprehend the fact that this is the reason I should do it and this is the reason I would excel in it.
The next aspect is weakness.
By weakness I mean the aspects where I either lack expertise or knowledge hence these are the areas where I need to earmark extra time and effort to make up for my shortcomings.
Next aspect is opportunity.
Opportunity clearly suggests the areas where I can capitalize on my expertize and gain the maximum out of it.
The last aspect of this analysis is threats.
Here threats do not mean physical threats but the factors that could impede my progress and could prove to be bottlenecks in achieving my ultimate goals.
It is true that no matter how much planning we do before beginning a task some untoward happening would happened and detriment our work.

But if we do give enough time to plan out things and create different scenarios in which we simulate the circumstances that how things could go wrong then a lot of time, effort and money can be saved.

And this is the primary reason that before taking up any task I always do SWOT analysis and simulate several scenarios to predict the outcome of my actions and my plans of how to counteract the negative outcomes of my actions.

I sincerely suggest to everybody that he or she should earmark some time for planning before initiating a task because I have seen that people do not give due respect to this part of the job and end up squandering a lot of time and resources.

sentences: Every year I go to some holiday destination with my family in summer vacations.
This is the time of the year I really look forward to because for few days I can completely forget my worries and enjoy to the fullest.
These vacations are refreshing for all of us and help to bring the family closer.
In the summer vacations of the last 5 years we have explored all the major hill stations in our part of the country.
I have a predilection for hilly areas as being a resident of a metro city I seldom get to see such beautiful sites full of greenery and fresh air.
All these visits have been really memorable but I particularly remember my visit to Dhanaulti.
It is a lesser known hill station in my state and has not been discovered by many people yet.

This is the reason its natural beauty has not been contaminated by commercialization as it has been done with other popular hilly areas which have become overcrowded over the years and are resembling more and more like cities.
There are vast expanses of green land in Dhanaulti and you can feel the freshness in the air at all times of the day.
I specifically remember one night when I was sitting in the balcony of our room and I was simply amazed after looking at the sky.
I had never seen the moonlight being so pristine before and stars were shining like diamonds.

Being a resident of a mainstream city, I barely get the chance and time to enjoy such moments and even if I try I know I can never get such a beautiful scenery in my city whose atmosphere is filled with pollution.
But that night in Dhanualti I got the chance to enjoy the beauty of nature live.
Incidentally that was a full moon night so the experience became more blissful.
Before that night I had never seen small bright objects moving in the sky.
But that night the sky was so clear that even the smallest of movements of objects was noticeable.
While I was marvelling at the beauty of the dark my father came and joined me.
He told me about the different constellations of the stars and their names and locations which he told we could never see in our city clearly.
He also told me about the brightest star in the sky, the Polestar and said that its location never changes.
He also shared his experiences when he was a kid and lived in a village, he too used sit at the terrace in the night and stare at the sky for hours.
For next half an hour both of us sat their quietly just looking at the sky and enjoying one of the most serene moments of my life.
I wish to enjoy more such experiences in my life because as my father says that we always remember the experiences and not material things we buy.
